Beth_Meriam/China_s__Tibetan__Frontiers_.author: Beth Meriam

The book examines how local agro-pastoralists have navigated successive Marxist class categorisation, post-1978 'reform and opening up', the labelling of Trinde residents as Tibetan nationality, and the rise of televisual media. Methodology: school-based participant observation in northeastern Kham. Field site: Trinde County, Yushu Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai. Published Brill / Global Oriental, Inner Asia Series vol. 6, 2012.

Burkhard_Schnepel/Travelling_pasts___the.title: Travelling pasts
Burkhard_Schnepel/Travelling_pasts___the.author: Burkhard Schnepel
Burkhard_Schnepel/Travelling_pasts___the.summary: Edited volume by Burkhard Schnepel and Tansen Sen examining how cultural heritage is mobilised and contested across the Indian Ocean world. Chapters cover UNESCO World Heritage politics, India's Project Mausam initiative, the Hajj as Saudi heritage, the Kalhuvakaru Mosque controversy in the Maldives, Cape Town's slave-era memory, Chinese diaspora temples in Kolkata and Kuala Lumpur, and the heritagisation of Zanzibar's Stone Town and Mayotte. Methodology: multi-sited ethnography of heritage practice and its politics. Field sites: Maldives, Patan/Mahabalipuram, Cape Town, Kolkata, Penang, Zanzibar, Mayotte. Published Brill, 2019.

CAROLE_McGRANAHAN/Arrested_Histories__Ti.title: Arrested Histories
CAROLE_McGRANAHAN/Arrested_Histories__Ti.author: Carole McGranahan
CAROLE_McGRANAHAN/Arrested_Histories__Ti.summary: Carole McGranahan's ethnography of historical memory among Khampa veterans of the Chushi Gangdrug Tibetan resistance army and the CIA-backed Mustang guerrilla operation against Chinese rule in Tibet. Based on 1994-2003 fieldwork in Boudha (Kathmandu), Dharamsala and other Himalayan refugee communities, plus interviews with retired CIA officers, the book argues that this 'forgotten war' has been arrested in Tibetan public memory by the politics of nonviolence and the Dalai Lama's exile leadership. Methodology: oral history and refugee ethnography. Field sites: Kathmandu, Dharamsala, Mustang, and U.S. archives at Yale and Stanford. Published Duke University Press, 2010.

Chaman_Lal/The_Political_Writings_of_Bha.title: The Political Writings of Bhagat Singh
Chaman_Lal/The_Political_Writings_of_Bha.author: Chaman Lal
Chaman_Lal/The_Political_Writings_of_Bha.summary: Chaman Lal and Michael D. Yates's edited collection of the political writings of Bhagat Singh (1907-1931), the Punjabi revolutionary executed by the British at Lahore Central Jail at age 23. Texts include Singh's essays on youth, untouchability, communal riots, anarchism, and 'Why I am an Atheist,' his courtroom statements, his last letters from prison, and excerpts from his jail notebooks on law and the state. The introduction by the editors traces his life from Lyallpur (now Faisalabad) through the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association to his execution. Field site: Punjab (textual). Published Monthly Review Press / LeftWord Books.

Chandler_Washburne/Rhamon__a_boy_of_Kash.author: Heluiz Chandler Washburne

Chandra_Roy/Anthropogeomorphology_of_Bha.author: Chandra Roy

Chandra_Roy/The_Hill_Bhuiyas_Of_Orissa__.title: The Hill Bhuiyas Of Orissa
Chandra_Roy/The_Hill_Bhuiyas_Of_Orissa__.author: Chandra Roy
Chandra_Roy/The_Hill_Bhuiyas_Of_Orissa__.summary: Sarat Chandra Roy's 1935 monograph on the Hill (Pauri) Bhuiyas of the Orissan tributary states, with comparative notes on the Hinduised Plains Bhuiyas. Roy argues that the Bhuiya tribe spans a continuum from primitive Hill cultivators in Keonjhar, Bonai and Pal Lahara to thoroughly Hinduised Zamindar lineages in Gangpur, illustrating tribal-to-caste transformation in eastern India. The volume covers economic life, kinship, marriage, religion, magic and folklore, drawing on the author's twenty-five years of fieldwork among the tribes of the Central Hill Belt. Field site: Keonjhar, Bonai, Pal Lahara, Gangpur (Orissa). Published from the Man in India Office, Ranchi, 1935.

Charles_Lindholm/Culture_and_Identity__T.summary: Charles Lindholm's Culture and Identity is a synthesis of psychological anthropology drawing extensively on his own ethnographic work among the Yusufzai Pukhtuns of Swat, Pakistan. Charles_Ramble/Taxation_in_Tibetan_Socie.summary: Charles Ramble's edited volume on rules, practices, and discourses of taxation in Tibetan societies, including Ladakh. Field site: Ladakh.

Charles_Ramble/The_Many_Faces_of_King_Ge.author: Charles Ramble

Charles_Stonor/The_Sherpa_And_The_Snowma.title: The Sherpa And The Snowman
Charles_Stonor/The_Sherpa_And_The_Snowma.author: Charles Stonor
Charles_Stonor/The_Sherpa_And_The_Snowma.summary: Charles Stonor's 1955 account of the Daily Mail Himalayan Expedition's investigation into Yeti reports among the Sherpas of Nepal's Khumbu region. Combining ethnographic observation of Sherpa village life, monastic festivals and yak-herding economies with cryptozoological inquiry, Stonor describes visits to Thami, Thyangboche, Pangboche and Phorche villages and the Gondah Monastery festival. The book is as much a record of mid-twentieth-century Sherpa society and its Tibetan Buddhist institutions as it is a Yeti hunt. Field site: Solu-Khumbu region of eastern Nepal. Published Hollis & Carter, London, 1955.

Charles_Theophilus_Metcalfe/The_life_and.title: The life and correspondence of Charles

Cambridge University Press, 2017.

Chitralekha/Kashmir__5007fc548ebefa1351c.title: Kashmir (Oxford India Short Introductions)

Chitralekha/Kashmir__5007fc548ebefa1351c.summary: Chitralekha Zutshi's accessible introduction to Kashmir's history, politics, and culture. Field site: Kashmir Valley, Jammu, Ladakh, Gilgit. Oxford University Press India, 2019.

Chitta_Ranjan_Nag/Mizo_Society_in_Transi.title: Mizo Society in Transition
Chitta_Ranjan_Nag/Mizo_Society_in_Transi.author: Chitta Ranjan Nag
Chitta_Ranjan_Nag/Mizo_Society_in_Transi.summary: Chitta Ranjan Nag's 1993 monograph adapting his 1975 Gauhati University Ph.D. on the impact of Christianity on Mizo society. Based on field research conducted between 1969 and 1979 while teaching at Pachhunga Memorial Government College in Aizawl, the book reconstructs traditional Mizo social structure, economy, politics, language, marriage, religion (including the Sakhua sacrifice and Pialral conception of paradise), and festivals, then traces transformation under British administration and Welsh Baptist Christian missions. Methodology: written records combined with verbal interviews and questionnaires of Mizo elders and missionaries. Field site: Mizoram, especially Aizawl and surrounding villages. Published Vikas, New Delhi, 1993.

F_A_Khan/THE_GLORY_THAT_WAS_MOHENJODARO_.author: Fazal Ahmad Khan
F_A_Khan/THE_GLORY_THAT_WAS_MOHENJODARO_.summary: F.A. Khan's illustrated booklet on Mohenjo-daro, written by the senior Pakistani archaeologist who later directed Department of Archaeology excavations at Banbhore. The text introduces lay readers to the Indus civilisation's chronology (c. 2250 BCE), its town planning and drainage at Mohenjo-daro and Harappa, the Great Bath and Great Granary, terracotta and bronze figurines (including the Dancing Girl), steatite seals with their pictographic script, weights and measures, and the four racial types in the Harappa cemetery. Methodology: site-based synthesis with photographs and a site plan. Field sites: Mohenjo-daro, Harappa, and other Indus valley sites. Published by the Department of Archaeology, Pakistan.

Fanny_Bullock_Workman/In_the_ice_world_o.title: In the Ice World of Himalaya Among the Peaks and Passes of Ladakh
Fanny_Bullock_Workman/In_the_ice_world_o.author: Fanny Bullock Workman
Fanny_Bullock_Workman/In_the_ice_world_o.summary: Fanny Bullock Workman's classic Edwardian travel narrative of mountaineering in Ladakh and Kashmir. Field sites: Ladakh, Srinagar, Karakoram passes.

Farhana_Ibrahim/From_Family_to_Police_Fo.title: From Family to Police Force: Security and Belonging on a South Asian Border
Farhana_Ibrahim/From_Family_to_Police_Fo.author: Farhana Ibrahim
Farhana_Ibrahim/From_Family_to_Police_Fo.summary: Farhana Ibrahim's ethnography of security and belonging in a South Asian borderland, drawing on fieldwork with Indian Border Security Force families in Kachchh, Gujarat (close to the Pakistani border). Field site: Kachchh, India.

Farhana_Ibrahim/South_Asian_Borderlands_.title: South Asian Borderlands: Mobility, History, Affect
Farhana_Ibrahim/South_Asian_Borderlands_.author: Farhana Ibrahim
Farhana_Ibrahim/South_Asian_Borderlands_.summary: Farhana Ibrahim and Tanuja Kothiyal's edited volume on mobility, history, and affect in South Asian borderlands. Field sites: South Asian frontiers.

Farooq_Sulehria/From_Terrorism_to_Televi.title: From Terrorism to Television
Farooq_Sulehria/From_Terrorism_to_Televi.author: Farooq Sulehria
Farooq_Sulehria/From_Terrorism_to_Televi.summary: Farooq Sulehria and Qaisar Abbas's edited volume on dynamics of media, state, and society in Pakistan from the dictator-era PTV to the post-2002 private-channel boom. Field site: Pakistan.

Farooq_Sulehria/Media_Imperialism_in_Ind.title: Media Imperialism in India and Pakistan
Farooq_Sulehria/Media_Imperialism_in_Ind.author: Farooq Sulehria
Farooq_Sulehria/Media_Imperialism_in_Ind.summary: Farooq Sulehria's analysis of media imperialism in South Asia — how transnational media corporations shape news and entertainment in India and Pakistan. Field site: India, Pakistan.

Farooq_Yousaf/Pakistan__Regional_Securit.title: Pakistan, Regional Security and Conflict Resolution: The Pashtun 'Tribal' Areas
Farooq_Yousaf/Pakistan__Regional_Securit.author: Farooq Yousaf
Farooq_Yousaf/Pakistan__Regional_Securit.summary: Farooq Yousaf interrogates how colonial legacies and the postcolonial Pakistani state have shaped the FATA tribal belt. Field site: former FATA agencies — Khyber, Waziristan, Bajaur, Orakzai, Mohmand. Argues for the centrality of the Pashtun jirga as an indigenous conflict-resolution mechanism that has been continuously co-opted, displaced, or undermined by colonial and successor administrations. Routledge / Springer, 2021.

Fatima_Mojaddedi/Mojaddedi_Columbia_PhD..title: Terrestrial Things: War, Language and Value in Afghanistan
Fatima_Mojaddedi/Mojaddedi_Columbia_PhD..author: Fatima Mojaddedi
Fatima_Mojaddedi/Mojaddedi_Columbia_PhD..summary: Fatima Mojaddedi's Columbia PhD dissertation on language and psychological dimensions of Afghan life amid militarized conflict. Drawing on long-term fieldwork in Kabul, examines how violence fragments social worlds. Field site: Kabul, Afghanistan.

Fernanda_Pirie/Conflict_and_Social_Order.title: Conflict and Social Order in Tibet and Inner Asia
Fernanda_Pirie/Conflict_and_Social_Order.author: Fernanda Pirie
Fernanda_Pirie/Conflict_and_Social_Order.summary: Fernanda Pirie's analysis of dispute resolution in Tibet and Inner Asia. Field site: Tibet, Ladakh.

Fernanda_Pirie/Peace_and_Conflict_in_Lad.title: Peace and Conflict in Ladakh: The Construction of a Fragile Web of Order
Fernanda_Pirie/Peace_and_Conflict_in_Lad.author: Fernanda Pirie
Fernanda_Pirie/Peace_and_Conflict_in_Lad.summary: Fernanda Pirie's anthropological study of dispute resolution and ritual in Ladakh's mountain villages. Field site: Ladakh — historically part of the Kashmir conflict orbit.

Filippo_Boni/China__Pakistan_and_the_Bel.title: China, Pakistan and the Belt and Road Initiative: The Experience of an Early Adopter State
Filippo_Boni/China__Pakistan_and_the_Bel.author: Filippo Boni
Filippo_Boni/China__Pakistan_and_the_Bel.summary: Filippo Boni's study of how the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) reshapes Pakistani politics, infrastructure, and regional geopolitics. Field sites: Gwadar, Balochistan, Sindh, Punjab.

Filippo_Boni/Sino-Pakistani_Relations__P.title: Sino-Pakistani Relations: Politics, Military and Regional Dynamics
Filippo_Boni/Sino-Pakistani_Relations__P.author: Filippo Boni
Filippo_Boni/Sino-Pakistani_Relations__P.summary: Filippo Boni's analysis of Sino-Pakistani relations and CPEC dynamics. Field site: Pakistan-China relations.

Fosco_Maraini/Secret_Tibet__secret-tibet.title: Secret Tibet
Fosco_Maraini/Secret_Tibet__secret-tibet.author: Fosco Maraini
Fosco_Maraini/Secret_Tibet__secret-tibet.summary: Fosco Maraini's narrative of his 1948 expedition to western and southern Tibet under the leadership of Giuseppe Tucci, with photographs by the author. Combining travelogue, ethnography and reflections on Tantric Buddhism and the Bon religion, the book chronicles the journey from Naples to Sikkim and into the Chumbi valley, Yatung, Phari, Gyantse and the Kum-bum, with extended encounters with the Living Bodhisattva of Dung-kar, the hermit Tsampa Tendar, and the politics of pre-1950 Tibet. Field site: southern Tibet (Chumbi, Yatung, Gyantse, Sakya) and Sikkim. Originally published Italian 1951; English translation Viking Press, 1952.

Fosco_Maraini/Where_Four_Worlds_Meet__Hi.title: Where Four Worlds Meet
Fosco_Maraini/Where_Four_Worlds_Meet__Hi.author: Fosco Maraini
Fosco_Maraini/Where_Four_Worlds_Meet__Hi.summary: Fosco Maraini's classic 1963 travel narrative of the Hindu Kush, focusing on Chitral, Kalash valleys, and the high passes connecting Pakistan, Afghanistan, and Central Asia. Field sites: Chitral, Peshawar.

Frank_J_Korom/Gender__Genre__and_Power_i.title: Gender, Genre, and Power in South Asian Expressive Traditions
Frank_J_Korom/Gender__Genre__and_Power_i.author: Frank J Korom
Frank_J_Korom/Gender__Genre__and_Power_i.summary: Frank J. Korom and Margaret Mills's edited volume on gender, genre, and power in South Asian expressive traditions. Field sites: Pashtun, Punjabi, Sindhi, and Bengali expressive culture.

Frank_J_Korom/Tibetan_Culture_in_the_Dia.title: Tibetan Culture in the Diaspora
Frank_J_Korom/Tibetan_Culture_in_the_Dia.author: Frank J Korom
Frank_J_Korom/Tibetan_Culture_in_the_Dia.summary: Frank J. Korom's edited volume from the seventh seminar of the International Association for Tibetan Studies (Graz 1995), addressing the cultural, economic and aesthetic politics of the post-1959 Tibetan diaspora. Contributions by Methfessel, Ström, Thargyal, Kalkowski, Klieger, McLagan, Schrempf and Huber treat refugee economic adaptation, monastic institution-building in exile, secularisation, performance politics, hyperreality and Shangri-La, the 'Year of Tibet' in Manhattan, and the reframing of devil dances as world healing. Field sites: Tibetan refugee communities in Dharamsala, Nepal, Bhutan and the West. Published by the Austrian Academy of Sciences, Vienna, 1997.

Fredrik_Barth/Political_Leadership_Among.title: Political Leadership Among Swat Pathans
Fredrik_Barth/Political_Leadership_Among.author: Fredrik Barth
Fredrik_Barth/Political_Leadership_Among.summary: Olaf Caroe's monumental history of the Pashtuns from 550 BCE to 1957, written by the last British governor of the North-West Frontier Province. A foundational work on Pashtun ethnogenesis, tribal organization (Yusufzai, Khattak, Afridi, Wazir, Mahsud), Pakhtunwali, and the colonial frontier. Field sites: Peshawar Division, FATA, eastern Afghanistan.

GLYN_WILLIAMS/Afghanistan_Declassified__.title: Afghanistan Declassified
GLYN_WILLIAMS/Afghanistan_Declassified__.author: Brian Glyn Williams
GLYN_WILLIAMS/Afghanistan_Declassified__.summary: Brian Glyn Williams's guide to America's longest war, drawing on the author's experiences as a CIA cultural advisor in Afghanistan. Field site: Afghanistan, especially Helmand and Kandahar.

GLYN_WILLIAMS/Counter_Jihad__America_s_M.title: Counter Jihad: America's Military Experience in Afghanistan, Iraq, and Syria
GLYN_WILLIAMS/Counter_Jihad__America_s_M.author: Brian Glyn Williams
GLYN_WILLIAMS/Counter_Jihad__America_s_M.summary: Brian Glyn Williams's history of America's military experience in Afghanistan and Iraq. Field sites: Afghanistan — Abbottabad, Peshawar.

GLYN_WILLIAMS/Seeing_the_State__Governan.title: Seeing the State
GLYN_WILLIAMS/Seeing_the_State__Governan.author: Glyn Williams
GLYN_WILLIAMS/Seeing_the_State__Governan.summary: Glyn Williams's 'Seeing the State' is an economic monograph on kinship, marriage, and family. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Introduction In recent years there has been a sea-change in the ways in which the state in India has sought to present itself to its poorest citizens.' Field site: Lohra. Published 2000 by Cambridge University Press.

GLYN_WILLIAMS/The_Last_Warlord__The_Life.title: The Last Warlord: The Life and Legend of Dostum, the Afghan Warrior Who Led US Special Forces to Topple the Taliban Regime
GLYN_WILLIAMS/The_Last_Warlord__The_Life.author: Brian Glyn Williams
GLYN_WILLIAMS/The_Last_Warlord__The_Life.summary: Brian Glyn Williams's biography of Abdul Rashid Dostum, the Uzbek warlord-vice-president of Afghanistan. Field site: northern Afghanistan, especially Jowzjan and Faryab.

G_C_Sharma_Thakur/The_Lalungs__in.gov.tr.title: The Lalungs
G_C_Sharma_Thakur/The_Lalungs__in.gov.tr.author: G C Sharma Thakur
G_C_Sharma_Thakur/The_Lalungs__in.gov.tr.summary: G.C. Sharma Thakur's 1985 monograph on the Tiwas (Lalungs), a plains-and-foothills tribe of central Assam concentrated in Nagaon district and the Hamren subdivision of Karbi Anglong, published by the Tribal Research Institute, Assam. The book covers material culture, life-cycle rites, social institutions, religious beliefs, festivals, language and the Tiwa kingship tradition centred on the Gobha Raja, drawing on the author's fieldwork in Tiwa villages and his interviews with the Gobha Raja and elders. Field sites: Nagaon district (Jagi Bhakatgaon, Barapujia) and Karbi Anglong, Assam. Published Guwahati, 1985.

G_N_Chaudhuri/The_History_and_Culture_of.title: The History and Culture of the Indian People
G_N_Chaudhuri/The_History_and_Culture_of.author: R.C. Majumdar
G_N_Chaudhuri/The_History_and_Culture_of.summary: Multi-volume reference history of Indian civilization from prehistory to modernity, originally edited by R.C. Majumdar. Standard scholarly compendium covering political dynasties, religion, art, and society across the South Asian subcontinent.

G_R_Hunter/The_script_of_Harappa_and_Moh.title: The Script of Harappa and Mohenjodaro and Its Connection with Other Scripts
G_R_Hunter/The_script_of_Harappa_and_Moh.author: G. R. Hunter
G_R_Hunter/The_script_of_Harappa_and_Moh.summary: G.R. Hunter's classic study of the Harappan script's connection to other ancient writing systems. Field sites: Harappa, Mohenjo-daro (Pakistan).

G_S_Ghurye/Caste_And_Class_In_India__Cas.title: Caste And Class In India
G_S_Ghurye/Caste_And_Class_In_India__Cas.author: G S Ghurye
G_S_Ghurye/Caste_And_Class_In_India__Cas.summary: G S Ghurye's 'Caste And Class In India' is an ethnographic monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'My book,-as extracts of some of the reviews so insistently printed by the present publishers will show, was almost uni-' versally well received.' Field site: Mehar. Published 1932 by G. R.

G_U_Pope/A_Text_Book_Of_Indian_History_T.title: A Text-book of Indian History
G_U_Pope/A_Text_Book_Of_Indian_History_T.author: George Uglow Pope
G_U_Pope/A_Text_Book_Of_Indian_History_T.summary: G.U. Pope's standard colonial-era textbook of Indian history. Field sites: undivided British India, including Peshawar, Lahore, Attock.

Ganga_Ram_Regmi/Hindu_Kush-Himalaya_Wate.title: Hindu Kush-Himalaya Watersheds Downhill: Landscape Ecology and Conservation Perspectives
Ganga_Ram_Regmi/Hindu_Kush-Himalaya_Wate.author: Ganga Ram Regmi
Ganga_Ram_Regmi/Hindu_Kush-Himalaya_Wate.summary: Ganga Ram Regmi et al.'s edited volume on landscape ecology and watershed management in the Hindu Kush-Himalaya. Field sites: Himalaya, Kashmir, Jammu.

Gauri_Shankar/Dogras_Their_Language_And_.title: Dogras Their Language And Literature
Gauri_Shankar/Dogras_Their_Language_And_.author: Gauri Shankar
Gauri_Shankar/Dogras_Their_Language_And_.summary: Gauri Shankar's study of the Dogra people's language and literature in Jammu. Field site: Jammu region, Kashmir.
Gauri_Shankar/Dogras_Their_Language_And_.original_title_pre_normalize: Dogras Their Language And Literature By Gauri Shankar Gauri Shankar

Gauri_Shankar/Kavi_Dutt_Granthavali_Lali.title: Kavi Dutt Granthavali Lalit Kala Sanskriti V Sahitya Academy JK Prof Gauri Shankar
Gauri_Shankar/Kavi_Dutt_Granthavali_Lali.author: Gauri Shankar
Gauri_Shankar/Kavi_Dutt_Granthavali_Lali.summary: Professor Gauri Shankar's critical Hindi edition of the complete works of the eighteenth-century Dogri-Hindi poet Datt of the court of Raja Ranjit Dev of Jammu, including the Vir Vilas (a verse rendering of the Drona Parva of the Mahabharata, 1761-1766 CE), the Brajraj Panchasika on the Kangra campaign, and the Baramah seasonal poem. The introduction reconstructs Datt's biography, his teacher and lineage, the manuscript history of his works, and his place in Hindi translation tradition. Field site: Jammu and surrounding Punjab Hill states (textual/archival). Published by the J&K Academy of Art, Culture and Languages, Jammu, 1965-66.

George_B_Schaller/Stones_of_Silence__Jou.title: Stones of Silence
George_B_Schaller/Stones_of_Silence__Jou.author: George B Schaller
George_B_Schaller/Stones_of_Silence__Jou.summary: George B. Schaller's natural-history account of his Himalayan expeditions tracking snow leopards, ibex, and Marco Polo sheep. Field sites: Chitral, Hunza-Nagar, Karakoram.

Gerald_Roche/AHP_4__China_s_Namzi_Tibeta.title: AHP 4 China s Namzi Tibetan Songs Engagement Chants Flute Music
Gerald_Roche/AHP_4__China_s_Namzi_Tibeta.author: Gerald Roche
Gerald_Roche/AHP_4__China_s_Namzi_Tibeta.summary: Gerald Roche's documentation of Namzi Tibetan songs. Field site: Tibet — peripheral.

Gerald_Roche/Namzi_Tibetan_Songs__Engage.title: Namzi Tibetan Songs
Gerald_Roche/Namzi_Tibetan_Songs__Engage.author: Gerald Roche
Gerald_Roche/Namzi_Tibetan_Songs__Engage.summary: Gerald Roche's edition of Namzi Tibetan engagement chants and flute music. Field site: Tibet — peripheral.

Gerard_Fussman/Antiquities_of_Northern_P.title: Antiquities of Northern Pakistan: Reports and Studies, Volume 3
Gerard_Fussman/Antiquities_of_Northern_P.author: Gérard Fussman
Gerard_Fussman/Antiquities_of_Northern_P.summary: Gerard Fussman et al.'s German Heidelberg-mission documentation of rock carvings and antiquities in Pakistan's Northern Areas, vol. 3. Field site: Gilgit-Baltistan, Hodar.

Ghulam_Ali/China-Pakistan_Relations__A_H.title: China-Pakistan Relations
Ghulam_Ali/China-Pakistan_Relations__A_H.author: Ghulam Ali
Ghulam_Ali/China-Pakistan_Relations__A_H.summary: Ghulam Ali's historical analysis of Sino-Pakistani relations from the 1950s to the present, covering all major bilateral crises. Field site: Pakistan-China relations.

Ghulam_Ali/Pakistan_s_Foreign_Policy__Co.title: Pakistan's Foreign Policy: Contemporary Developments and Dynamics
Ghulam_Ali/Pakistan_s_Foreign_Policy__Co.author: Ghulam Ali
Ghulam_Ali/Pakistan_s_Foreign_Policy__Co.summary: Ghulam Ali's textbook on Pakistan's foreign policy in the post-2001 era, covering the China-US triangulation, Afghanistan policy, and India relations. Field site: Pakistan's foreign-policy machinery.

Ghulam_Ali/Perspectives_on_Contemporary_.title: Perspectives on Contemporary Pakistan: Governance, Development and Environment
Ghulam_Ali/Perspectives_on_Contemporary_.author: Ghulam Ali
Ghulam_Ali/Perspectives_on_Contemporary_.summary: Ghulam Ali et al.'s edited volume on contemporary Pakistani governance, development, and political economy. Field site: Pakistan.

Ghulam_Nabi/Of_Militarisation__Counter-i.title: Of Militarisation, Counter-insurgency and Land Grabs in Kashmir
Ghulam_Nabi/Of_Militarisation__Counter-i.author: Ghulam Nabi
Ghulam_Nabi/Of_Militarisation__Counter-i.summary: Ghulam Nabi Bhat's article on militarisation and land-grabs in Kashmir. Field sites: Kupwara, Srinagar.

Ghulam_Nabi/Pieces_of_Earth__The_Politic.title: Pieces of Earth: The Politics of Land-Grabbing in Kashmir
Ghulam_Nabi/Pieces_of_Earth__The_Politic.author: Ghulam Nabi
Ghulam_Nabi/Pieces_of_Earth__The_Politic.summary: Ghulam Nabi Bhat's analysis of the politics of land-grabbing in Indian-administered Kashmir — military, mining, and tourism appropriations. Field site: Kashmir Valley.

Gilles_Dorronsoro/The_Taliban_s_winning_.title: The Taliban's winning strategy in Afghanistan
Gilles_Dorronsoro/The_Taliban_s_winning_.author: Gilles Dorronsoro
Gilles_Dorronsoro/The_Taliban_s_winning_.summary: Gilles Dorronsoro's analysis of the Taliban's winning strategy in Afghanistan. Field sites: Quetta, Gardez, Kunduz.

Giuseppe_Tucci/MINOR_BUDDHIST_TEXTS__Par.title: Minor Buddhist Texts
Giuseppe_Tucci/MINOR_BUDDHIST_TEXTS__Par.author: Giuseppe Tucci
Giuseppe_Tucci/MINOR_BUDDHIST_TEXTS__Par.summary: Giuseppe Tucci's translation and analysis of secondary Tibetan and Sanskrit Buddhist sources, complementing his major works on Tibetan religion. Drawn from Tucci's expeditions to western Tibet and the Hindu Kush region.

Giuseppe_Tucci/Secrets_Of_Tibet__in.erne.title: Secrets Of Tibet
Giuseppe_Tucci/Secrets_Of_Tibet__in.erne.author: Giuseppe Tucci
Giuseppe_Tucci/Secrets_Of_Tibet__in.erne.summary: Giuseppe Tucci's 'Secrets Of Tibet' is a historical monograph on politics law and social organization and religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Toling and Tsaparang to stimulate further curiosity which can only be satisfied by the despatch of a competent Tibetan expert to both places with full permission to study their antiquities at leisure, and to hunt for inscriptions.' Field site: Ladākh, Sarang. Published 2015.

Giuseppe_Tucci/The_Ancient_Civilization_.title: The Ancient Civilization of Transhimalaya
Giuseppe_Tucci/The_Ancient_Civilization_.author: Giuseppe Tucci
Giuseppe_Tucci/The_Ancient_Civilization_.summary: Giuseppe Tucci's monograph on the ancient civilization of the Transhimalaya region. Field sites: Ladakh, Gilgit.

Giuseppe_Tucci/The_Religions_of_Tibet__2.title: The Religions of Tibet
Giuseppe_Tucci/The_Religions_of_Tibet__2.author: Giuseppe Tucci
Giuseppe_Tucci/The_Religions_of_Tibet__2.summary: Giuseppe Tucci's authoritative survey of Tibetan religion, originally published in German in 1970 and translated by Geoffrey Samuel. The book traces the first and second diffusions of Buddhism in Tibet, the rise of the Sakya, Kagyu, Nyingma, Geluk and Jonang schools, the doctrinal foundations of Mahayana and Vajrayana, the Bla na med rgyud Tantric process, monastic organisation, the religious calendar, and folk religion (protective deities, soul beliefs, divination), closing with a substantial chapter on the indigenous Bon religion. Methodology: textual scholarship combined with extensive fieldwork in Tibet. Field site: Tibet (philological/ethnographic). Published Routledge & Kegan Paul, 1980.

Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibet__Land_of_Snows__tib.title: Tibet: Land of Snows
Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibet__Land_of_Snows__tib.author: Giuseppe Tucci
Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibet__Land_of_Snows__tib.summary: Giuseppe Tucci's illustrated synthesis of Tibetan civilisation, drawing on his eight scholarly expeditions to Tibet between 1927 and 1948. Chapters cover history, religion (Buddhism and Bon), art, daily life, life-cycle ritual, literature and pre-1959 administration, with particular strength on the monastic art collections at Sakya, Narthang, Shalu, Ngor, Kongkardzong, Reting and Samye. Methodology: a blend of philological, art-historical and field observation, anchored in Tucci's mastery of Tibetan and Sanskrit sources. Field sites: central and western Tibet (especially Sakya, Gyantse, Lhasa, Shigatse) and Ladakh. Translated from Italian; published Elek Books, London, 1967.

Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibetan_Painted_Scrolls_V.title: Tibetan Painted Scrolls, Volume 2
Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibetan_Painted_Scrolls_V.author: Giuseppe Tucci
Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibetan_Painted_Scrolls_V.summary: Giuseppe Tucci's classic two-volume study of Tibetan painted scrolls (thangkas), drawing on his Tibetan expeditions. Field sites: Tibet, Ladakh — for the regional Buddhist art context.

Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibetan_folk_songs_from_G.title: Tibetan Folk Songs from Gyantse and Western Tibet
Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibetan_folk_songs_from_G.author: Giuseppe Tucci
Giuseppe_Tucci/Tibetan_folk_songs_from_G.summary: Giuseppe Tucci's collection of Tibetan folk songs (love songs, drinking songs, ritual verses) gathered during his expeditions to Gyantse and Western Tibet, with parallel Tibetan and Italian/English text. Includes two appendices by Namkhai Norbu on song genres and musical context. Originally published 1949; this is the second, revised and enlarged edition (1966) issued by Artibus Asiae. A foundational ethnomusicological reference for Tibetan oral traditions outside the monastic canon. Field site: Gyantse and western Tibet (including Ladakh borderlands).

Giuseppe_Tucci/Travels_of_Tibetan_Pilgri.title: Travels of Tibetan Pilgrims in the Swat Valley
Giuseppe_Tucci/Travels_of_Tibetan_Pilgri.author: Giuseppe Tucci
Giuseppe_Tucci/Travels_of_Tibetan_Pilgri.summary: Giuseppe Tucci's classic study of Buddhist Tibetan pilgrim travels through the Swat Valley. Field sites: Buner, Swat, Ladakh.

Grant_Charles/The_gazetteer_of_the_Centr.title: The gazetteer of the Central Provinces of India
Grant_Charles/The_gazetteer_of_the_Centr.author: Sir Charles Grant
Grant_Charles/The_gazetteer_of_the_Centr.summary: British colonial gazetteer of the Central Provinces. Field sites: undivided subcontinent.

Gregory_L_Possehl/Harappan_Civilization_.title: Harappan Civilization and Rojdi
Gregory_L_Possehl/Harappan_Civilization_.author: Gregory L. Possehl
Gregory_L_Possehl/Harappan_Civilization_.summary: Gregory L. Possehl's archaeological monograph on Harappan civilization, with the Rojdi excavations. Field sites: Bahawalpur, Harappa.

Gurbinder_Singh/The_Sikh_Studies_And_The.title: The Sikh Studies and The British Administration: Case of M.A. Macauliffe
Gurbinder_Singh/The_Sikh_Studies_And_The.author: Gurbinder Singh
Gurbinder_Singh/The_Sikh_Studies_And_The.summary: Gurbinder Singh's 'The Sikh Studies And The British Administration' is a historical monograph on politics law and social organization and religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Ultimately, Emperor Shah Alam entrusted his affairs to Mahadji Sindhia and appointed him as Vakil-i-Mutlaq on Dec.' Field site: Rawalpindi Division. Published 2012.

Gustav_Salomon_Oppert/On_the_Original_In.title: On the Original Inhabitants of Bharatavarsa or India
Gustav_Salomon_Oppert/On_the_Original_In.author: Gustav Salomon Oppert
Gustav_Salomon_Oppert/On_the_Original_In.summary: Gustav Salomon Oppert's late-19th-century anthropological treatise on India's original inhabitants. Field site: undivided subcontinent.

Gustav_Salomon_Oppert/The_Dravidians__On.title: The Dravidians
Gustav_Salomon_Oppert/The_Dravidians__On.author: Gustav Salomon Oppert
Gustav_Salomon_Oppert/The_Dravidians__On.summary: Gustav Salomon Oppert's classic 1893 study of Dravidian peoples. Field site: south India.

HENRY_MONTGOMERY/Essays__military_and_po.title: Essays, Military and Political, Written in India
HENRY_MONTGOMERY/Essays__military_and_po.author: HENRY MONTGOMERY
HENRY_MONTGOMERY/Essays__military_and_po.summary: Henry Montgomery's 'Sib Heney Montgomeey Lawbexce, K.c.b.' is a historical monograph on the body, health, and life cycle. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'The Essays comprising tliis volume were contributed by Sir Henry Lawrence to the Calcutta Beview.' Field site: Kalat Division. Published 1859 by Sage.

HENRY_MONTGOMERY/Essays_military_and_pol.title: Essays Military and Political Written in India
HENRY_MONTGOMERY/Essays_military_and_pol.author: HENRY MONTGOMERY
HENRY_MONTGOMERY/Essays_military_and_pol.summary: Henry Montgomery's 'Essays Military and Political Written in India' is a historical monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'This process relies on optical character recognition, and is somewhat susceptible to errors.' Field site: Sindh, Kalat Division. Published 1996.

Javed_Iqbal/A_Study_of_Research_Trends_a.summary: Mazhar Iqbal, Akhtar Ali and Muhammad Javed's documentary analysis of 1,132 Master's-level theses in education submitted between 1988 and 2008 at five Punjab universities — Bahauddin Zakariya University Multan, The Islamia University of Bahawalpur, Government College University Faisalabad, University of the Punjab Lahore, and University of Sargodha. The authors classify each thesis by methodology and topical area, finding heavy concentration in teacher education and severe neglect of guidance and counselling, and recommend a national encyclopedia of educational research. Methodology: content analysis of thesis abstracts. Field sites: educational departments in Multan, Bahawalpur, Faisalabad, Lahore and Sargodha. Published in Bulletin of Education and Research, 2018.

Javed_Iqbal/Comparative_analysis_of_emer.title: Comparative Analysis of Emergency Response Operations: Haiti Earthquake in January 2010 and Pakistan's Flood in 2010
Javed_Iqbal/Comparative_analysis_of_emer.author: Javed Iqbal
Javed_Iqbal/Comparative_analysis_of_emer.summary: Javed Iqbal's 'Comparative Analysis of Emergency Response Operations Haiti Earthquake in January 2010 and Pakistan S Flood in 2010' is a historical monograph on subject_unknown. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Services, Directorate for Information Operations and Reports, 1215 Jefferson Davis Highway, Suite 1204, Arlington, VA 22202-4302, and to the Office of Management and Budget, Paperwork Reduction Project (0704-0188) Washington DC 20503.' Field site: Anantnag. Published 2010.

Johann_Jakob_Meyer/Sexual_life_in_ancien.title: Sexual Life in Ancient India
Johann_Jakob_Meyer/Sexual_life_in_ancien.author: Johann Jakob Meyer
Johann_Jakob_Meyer/Sexual_life_in_ancien.summary: Johann Jakob Meyer's classic 1930s study of sexuality in ancient India. Field sites: undivided subcontinent.

John_Clark/Abridgment_History_Of_India__.title: Abridgment History Of India
John_Clark/Abridgment_History_Of_India__.author: John Clark
John_Clark/Abridgment_History_Of_India__.summary: John Clark Marshman's abridgment history of India. Field sites: undivided subcontinent — Quetta, Attock, Pattan.

John_Clark/Memoirs_Of_Major-general_Sir_.title: Memoirs of Major-General Sir Henry Havelock, K.C.B.
John_Clark/Memoirs_Of_Major-general_Sir_.author: John Clark
John_Clark/Memoirs_Of_Major-general_Sir_.summary: John Clark's 'Memoirs Of Major-general Sir Henry Havelock' is a religious-studies monograph on kinship, marriage, and family. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'THE publication of this volume has been postponed to afford time for the collection of materials for a more complete Life of General IIavelock than has yet appeared.' Field site: Khyber Agency. Published 2015.

John_Clark/Ridpath_s_history_of_the_worl.title: Ridpath S History of the World
John_Clark/Ridpath_s_history_of_the_worl.author: John Clark Ridpath
John_Clark/Ridpath_s_history_of_the_worl.summary: John Clark's 'Ridpath S History of the World' is a historical monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Afghanistan, Pakistan. From the opening: 'It is not needed in this connection to dwell in extenso on the minor modifications which have suggested themselves in the composition of these volumes.' Field site: Jalālābād, Sahiwal. Published 1809.

John_F_Shroder/Afghanistan__Modern_World.title: Afghanistan (Modern World Nations)
John_F_Shroder/Afghanistan__Modern_World.author: John F Shroder
John_F_Shroder/Afghanistan__Modern_World.summary: John F Shroder's 'Bosnia and Herzegovina' is a historical monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Afghanistan. From the opening: 'B efore the last two decades of warfare there, visitors to Afghanistan often had the feeling that they had stepped into the past.' Field site: Pas̲h̲tūnistān. Published 1978.

Jurgen_Wasim_Frembgen/Marginality__Sexua.title: Marginality, Sexuality and the Body: Professional Masseurs in Urban Muslim Punjab
Jurgen_Wasim_Frembgen/Marginality__Sexua.author: Jürgen Wasim Frembgen
Jurgen_Wasim_Frembgen/Marginality__Sexua.summary: Jurgen Wasim Frembgen's ethnography of Pakistani khwaja-sira (eunuch / hijra) performance and ritual labor at Sufi shrines and weddings. Field site: Punjab (Lahore, Multan), Sindh (Karachi). Examines how eunuchs occupy a marginal but ritually charged position in Pakistani society. Published in Indian Folklife (NFSC), 2008.

Jurgen_Wasim_Frembgen/Saints_in_Modern_D.title: Saints in Modern Devotional Poster-Portraits
Jurgen_Wasim_Frembgen/Saints_in_Modern_D.author: Jürgen Wasim Frembgen
Jurgen_Wasim_Frembgen/Saints_in_Modern_D.summary: Jurgen Wasim Frembgen's 'Saints in Modern Devotional Poster-Portraits' is a religious-studies work on politics law and social organization and religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'As a respected tabarruk or amulet, it has also the magical power to protect the house.' Field site: Rawalpindi Division. Published 1998.

Jyoti_Bhusan_Das_Gupta/Jammu_and_Kashmir.title: Jammu and Kashmir
Jyoti_Bhusan_Das_Gupta/Jammu_and_Kashmir.author: Jyoti Bhusan Das Gupta
Jyoti_Bhusan_Das_Gupta/Jammu_and_Kashmir.summary: Jyoti Bhusan Das Gupta's detailed historical-political study of Jammu & Kashmir from 1947 to the late twentieth century. Reconstructs the legal, diplomatic, and military dimensions of the dispute. Field sites: Srinagar, Jammu, Muzaffarabad.

Kamran_Asdar_Ali/Communism_in_Pakistan__.title: Communism in Pakistan
Kamran_Asdar_Ali/Communism_in_Pakistan__.author: Kamran Asdar Ali
Kamran_Asdar_Ali/Communism_in_Pakistan__.summary: Kamran Asdar Ali's history of left politics and labor activism in Pakistan from 1947-1972. Field sites: Karachi, Lahore.

Kamran_Asdar_Ali/Towards_Peoples__Histor.title: Towards Peoples' Histories in Pakistan: (In)audible Voices, Forgotten Pasts
Kamran_Asdar_Ali/Towards_Peoples__Histor.author: Kamran Asdar Ali
Kamran_Asdar_Ali/Towards_Peoples__Histor.summary: Kamran Asdar Ali's edited volume on people's histories in Pakistan — labor, women, peasants, and dissidents whose voices are often inaudible in official narratives. Field site: Pakistan.

Karen_Leonard/Indo-Muslim_Cultures_in_Tr.title: Indo-Muslim Cultures in Transition
Karen_Leonard/Indo-Muslim_Cultures_in_Tr.author: Karen Isaksen Leonard
Karen_Leonard/Indo-Muslim_Cultures_in_Tr.summary: Karen Leonard's history of Indo-Muslim cultures in transition. Field sites: undivided India, with attention to Hyderabad.

Karen_Leonard/Locating_Home__India_s_Hyd.title: Locating Home
Karen_Leonard/Locating_Home__India_s_Hyd.author: Karen Isaksen Leonard
Karen_Leonard/Locating_Home__India_s_Hyd.summary: Karen Leonard's ethnography of Hyderabadis abroad — the diasporic communities of former Hyderabad State (Deccan India) in the US, UK, and Gulf. Field sites: Hyderabad-origin diaspora.

Karen_Leonard/Making_ethnic_choices__Cal.title: Making Ethnic Choices: California's Punjabi Mexican Americans
Karen_Leonard/Making_ethnic_choices__Cal.author: Karen Isaksen Leonard
Karen_Leonard/Making_ethnic_choices__Cal.summary: Karen Leonard's classic ethnography of Punjabi-Mexican-American communities in California. Field sites: California, Punjabi diaspora.

Karl_Jettmar/Cultures_of_the_Hindukush__.title: Cultures of the Hindukush: Selected Papers from the Hindu-Kush Cultural Conference Held at Moesgård 1970
Karl_Jettmar/Cultures_of_the_Hindukush__.author: Karl Jettmar
Karl_Jettmar/Cultures_of_the_Hindukush__.summary: Cultures of the Hindukush, edited by Karl Jettmar, gathers selected papers from the 1970 Moesgaard Hindu Kush Cultural Conference, surveying the ethnography, religion, and material culture of Nuristan, Chitral, and the upper Indus valleys. Contributors include Schuyler Jones, Lennart Edelberg, and Jettmar himself. Field sites: Nuristan, Chitral, Hunza, Gilgit. Methodology: collected ethnographic and archaeological essays. Published 1974 by Franz Steiner.

Karl_Jettmar/The_Voice_Of_The_Nightingal.title: The Voice of the Nightingale: A Personal Account of the Wakhi Culture in Hunza
Karl_Jettmar/The_Voice_Of_The_Nightingal.author: Sabine Felmy
Karl_Jettmar/The_Voice_Of_The_Nightingal.summary: Karl Jettmar's The Voice of the Nightingale is a personal ethnographic account of Wakhi-speaking Ismaili communities in upper Hunza, drawing on decades of fieldwork in Gojal. The book documents Wakhi oral poetry, kinship, and seasonal pastoral movement. Field site: upper Hunza Valley (Gojal), Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. Methodology: ethnographic fieldwork with Wakhi informants. Published 1996.

Laura_A_Ring/Zenana__Everyday_Peace_in_a.title: Zenana: Everyday Peace in a Karachi Apartment Building
Laura_A_Ring/Zenana__Everyday_Peace_in_a.author: Laura A Ring
Laura_A_Ring/Zenana__Everyday_Peace_in_a.summary: Laura A. Ring's ethnography of a multi-ethnic, middle-class high-rise apartment building in Karachi, where she lived with her Pakistani in-laws. Argues that peace between Sindhi, Mohajir, Pashtun, and Punjabi households is the product of relentless daily labor performed by women in the zenana — visiting, borrowing, lending, and managing male anger. Links the psychological idiom of 'tension' to anthropological theories of exchange, showing that ethnic difference is borne and sustained rather than resolved. A canonical urban ethnography of Pakistan's largest city. Field site: Karachi.

Laurence_Louer/Pan-Islamic_connections__.title: Pan-Islamic connections
Laurence_Louer/Pan-Islamic_connections__.author: Laurence Louër
Laurence_Louer/Pan-Islamic_connections__.summary: Laurence Louër's edited volume on transnational networks linking South Asian Muslims to the Arabian Peninsula. Covers labor migration, religious pilgrimage, and political/financial flows. Field site: Pakistan, India, the Gulf states.

Laurence_Louer/Sunnis_And_Shi_a__A_Polit.title: Sunnis and Shi'a: A Political History of Discord
Laurence_Louer/Sunnis_And_Shi_a__A_Polit.author: Laurence Louër
Laurence_Louer/Sunnis_And_Shi_a__A_Polit.summary: Laurence Louër's political history of Sunni-Shia discord in the modern Middle East and South Asia, including Pakistani sectarian violence. Field sites: Pakistan, the Gulf states.

Laurence_Louer/The_Islamic_Connection__0.title: The Islamic Connection
Laurence_Louer/The_Islamic_Connection__0.author: Laurence Louër
Laurence_Louer/The_Islamic_Connection__0.summary: Laurence Louër's edited volume on the Afghan-Pakistan jihadist connection and its transnational reach. Field sites: Kunar, Peshawar, Anantnag.

Laurence_Louer/Transnational_Shia_Politi.title: Transnational Shia Politics
Laurence_Louer/Transnational_Shia_Politi.author: Laurence Louër
Laurence_Louer/Transnational_Shia_Politi.summary: Laurence Louër's study of religious and political networks linking Shia communities across the Middle East and South Asia. Field sites: Pakistan, Iran, Iraq, Gulf states.

Laurent_Gayer/Karachi__Ordered_Disorder_.title: Karachi: Ordered Disorder and the Struggle for the City
Laurent_Gayer/Karachi__Ordered_Disorder_.author: Laurent Gayer
Laurent_Gayer/Karachi__Ordered_Disorder_.summary: Laurent Gayer's classic ethnography of violence in Karachi — how political parties (MQM, PPP, ANP), criminal networks, and security forces produce 'ordered disorder' in Pakistan's largest city. Field site: Karachi.

Laurent_Gayer/Muslims_In_Indian_Cities__.title: Muslims in Indian Cities: Trajectories of Marginalisation
Laurent_Gayer/Muslims_In_Indian_Cities__.author: Laurent Gayer
Laurent_Gayer/Muslims_In_Indian_Cities__.summary: Laurent Gayer and Christophe Jaffrelot's edited volume on Muslim trajectories of marginalization in Indian cities. Field sites: India — peripheral to the PAK/AFG focus.

Lawrence_Ziring/Iran__Turkey_and_Afghani.title: CBS Educational and Professional Publishing
Lawrence_Ziring/Iran__Turkey_and_Afghani.author: Lawrence Ziring
Lawrence_Ziring/Iran__Turkey_and_Afghani.summary: Lawrence Ziring's political chronology of Iran, Turkey, and Afghanistan. Field sites: Iran, Turkey, Afghanistan.

Lawrence_Ziring/Pakistan_Enigma_Politica.title: Pakistan: The Enigma of Political Development
Lawrence_Ziring/Pakistan_Enigma_Politica.author: Lawrence Ziring
Lawrence_Ziring/Pakistan_Enigma_Politica.summary: Lawrence Ziring's classic political history of Pakistan from independence to the early 1980s. Field site: Pakistan.

Lawrence_Ziring/Pakistan_in_the_Twentiet.title: Pakistan in the Twentieth Century
Lawrence_Ziring/Pakistan_in_the_Twentiet.author: Lawrence Ziring
Lawrence_Ziring/Pakistan_in_the_Twentiet.summary: Lawrence Ziring's standard political history of Pakistan from independence through the late 1990s. Field site: Pakistan, with attention to Karachi and Islamabad.

Lawrence_Ziring/The_Ayub_Khan_Era__Polit.title: The Ayub Khan Era: Politics in Pakistan, 1958-1969
Lawrence_Ziring/The_Ayub_Khan_Era__Polit.author: Lawrence Ziring
Lawrence_Ziring/The_Ayub_Khan_Era__Polit.summary: Lawrence Ziring's history of Pakistan during the Ayub Khan dictatorship (1958-1969). Field site: Pakistan.

Louis_Dupree/1980-dec_31__0b6dbb904a349e.title: Afghanistan
Louis_Dupree/1980-dec_31__0b6dbb904a349e.author: Louis Dupree
Louis_Dupree/1980-dec_31__0b6dbb904a349e.summary: Louis Dupree's encyclopedic single-volume ethnography and history of Afghanistan, drawing on two decades of archaeological and anthropological fieldwork. Field sites: nationwide — Kabul, Herat, Mazar-i-Sharif, Bamiyan, Nuristan, Pashtun belt, Hazarajat. The reference text for the field. Princeton University Press, 1973 (Dec 1980 reprint).

Louis_Dupree/Deh_Morasi_Ghundai__A_Chalc.title: Deh Morasi Ghundai: A Chalcolithic Site in South-Central Afghanistan
Louis_Dupree/Deh_Morasi_Ghundai__A_Chalc.author: Louis Dupree
Louis_Dupree/Deh_Morasi_Ghundai__A_Chalc.summary: Louis Dupree's archaeological monograph on the 1951 excavation of Deh Morasi Ghundai, a 4th-millennium BCE Chalcolithic mound near Kandahar. Field site: Deh Morasi Ghundai, Kandahar Province, southern Afghanistan. Documents stratigraphy, ceramics, lithics, and a copper compartmented seal indicating links to Iranian Plateau Chalcolithic cultures. Anthropological Papers of the American Museum of Natural History, vol. 50, part 2 (1963).

Louis_Dupree/The_Modernization_of_Inner_.title: The Modernization of Inner Asia
Louis_Dupree/The_Modernization_of_Inner_.author: Louis Dupree
Louis_Dupree/The_Modernization_of_Inner_.summary: Edited volume bringing together specialists on the Soviet and post-Soviet Central Asian republics, Mongolia, Tibet, Xinjiang, and Afghanistan to compare 20th-century state-led modernization programs. Field sites: Soviet Central Asia, Afghanistan (Dupree's chapters), Mongolia, Tibet, Xinjiang. Themes: collectivization, secularization, infrastructural integration, and resistance. M.E. Sharpe, 1991.

Luca_M_Olivieri/Stoneyards_and_Artists_i.title: Stoneyards and Artists in Gandhara. The Buddhist Stupa of Saidu Sharif I
Luca_M_Olivieri/Stoneyards_and_Artists_i.author: Luca Maria Olivieri
Luca_M_Olivieri/Stoneyards_and_Artists_i.summary: Luca M. Olivieri's archaeological monograph on the Buddhist stupa of Saidu Sharif and stoneyards/artist organization in Gandhara. Field sites: Mingora, Swat (Pakistan).

Luca_Maria_Olivieri/Lords_of_the_Mountai.title: Lords of the Mountains: Pre-Islamic Heritage along the Upper Indus in Pakistan
Luca_Maria_Olivieri/Lords_of_the_Mountai.author: Luca Maria Olivieri
Luca_Maria_Olivieri/Lords_of_the_Mountai.summary: Recent archaeological monograph by Italian archaeologist Luca Maria Olivieri synthesizing decades of Italian excavations in the Swat valley. Reconstructs the Buddhist art, urbanism, and ruling dynasties of pre-Islamic northwest Pakistan.

Luca_Maria_Olivieri/Pictures_in_Transfor.title: Pictures in Transformation: Rock Art Research between Central Asia and the Subcontinent
Luca_Maria_Olivieri/Pictures_in_Transfor.author: Luca Maria Olivieri
Luca_Maria_Olivieri/Pictures_in_Transfor.summary: Luca Maria Olivieri's research on rock-art in Central Asian and Pakistan contexts, with attention to Swat-valley petroglyphs. Field site: Swat, Ladakh, Central Asia.

Luca_Maria_Olivieri/View_From_Malakand__.title: View From Malakand
Luca_Maria_Olivieri/View_From_Malakand__.author: Luca Maria Olivieri
Luca_Maria_Olivieri/View_From_Malakand__.summary: Luca Maria Olivieri's view from Malakand on the archaeological and cultural heritage of Swat valley. Field site: Swat, Pakistan.

Ludwig_W_Adamec/First_Supplement_To_The_.title: First Supplement To The Who's Who of Afghanistan Democratic Republic of Afghanistan
Ludwig_W_Adamec/First_Supplement_To_The_.author: Ludwig W. Adamec
Ludwig_W_Adamec/First_Supplement_To_The_.summary: Ludwig W Adamec's 'First Supplement To The Who's Who of Afghanistan Democratic Republic of Afghanistan' is an other monograph on language and communication. Regional focus: Afghanistan. From the opening: 'Taught aviation and air traffic control and communications at the Air Authority Opera- tional Control Center, 1955-65.' Field site: Paghmān. Published 1979.

Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_And_Political.title: Historical And Political Gazetteer Of Afghanistan
Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_And_Political.author: Ludwig W. Adamec
Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_And_Political.summary: Ludwig W. Adamec's six-volume gazetteer of Afghan provinces, districts, and towns, drawing on British colonial records. A foundational reference for Afghan historical geography. Field site: Afghanistan, province by province.

Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_Dictionary_of.title: Historical Dictionary of Afghanistan
Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_Dictionary_of.author: Ludwig W. Adamec
Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_Dictionary_of.summary: Ludwig W. Adamec's Historical Dictionary of Afghanistan (now in its 4th edition, 2012) provides the standard reference work on Afghan persons, places, dynasties, and ethnic groups from prehistoric times through the post-2001 era. Field site: pan-Afghanistan; reference work. Methodology: synthetic reference compilation. Published by Scarecrow Press.

Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_and_Political.title: Historical and Political Gazetteer of Afghanistan Badakhshan Province and Northeastern Afghanistan
Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_and_Political.author: Ludwig W. Adamec
Ludwig_W_Adamec/Historical_and_Political.summary: Volume of Ludwig Adamec's six-volume Afghan gazetteer covering Badakhshan and the northeastern provinces (Wakhan Corridor, Pamirs). Drawn from British colonial records. Field site: northeastern Afghanistan.

Ludwig_W_Adamec/The_A_to_Z_of_Afghan_War.title: The A to Z of Afghan Wars
Ludwig_W_Adamec/The_A_to_Z_of_Afghan_War.author: Ludwig W. Adamec
Ludwig_W_Adamec/The_A_to_Z_of_Afghan_War.summary: Ludwig W. Adamec's reference companion to Afghanistan's revolutions and insurgencies. Field sites: Afghanistan — Khost, Maywand, Peshawar borderlands.

M_Nazif_Shahrani/Modern_Afghanistan__The.title: Modern Afghanistan
M_Nazif_Shahrani/Modern_Afghanistan__The.author: M. Nazif Shahrani
M_Nazif_Shahrani/Modern_Afghanistan__The.summary: M. Nazif Shahrani's edited volume on the impact of forty years of war on Afghan society. Contributors include Afghan and international scholars. Field site: Afghanistan.

M_Nazif_Shahrani/Revolutions_and_Rebelli.title: Revolutions and Rebellions in Afghanistan: Anthropological Perspectives
M_Nazif_Shahrani/Revolutions_and_Rebelli.author: M. Nazif Shahrani
M_Nazif_Shahrani/Revolutions_and_Rebelli.summary: M. Nazif Shahrani's edited volume on Afghan revolutions and rebellions, with anthropological perspectives. Field site: Afghanistan, Nuristan.

M_Nazif_Shahrani/The_Kirghiz_and_Wakhi_o.title: The Kirghiz and Wakhi of Afghanistan
M_Nazif_Shahrani/The_Kirghiz_and_Wakhi_o.author: M. Nazif Shahrani
M_Nazif_Shahrani/The_Kirghiz_and_Wakhi_o.summary: M. Nazif Shahrani's classic ethnography of the high-altitude Kirghiz and Wakhi pastoralists of the Afghan Pamirs (Wakhan Corridor). Documents adaptation to closed frontiers after the 1947 partition cut traditional pastoral routes. Field site: Wakhan Corridor, Badakhshan, Afghanistan.

M_Taimur_S_Khan/A_Moving_Heart__Querying.title: A Moving Heart: Querying a Singular Problem of "Immobility" in Afghan Migration to the UK
M_Taimur_S_Khan/A_Moving_Heart__Querying.author: Nichola Khan
M_Taimur_S_Khan/A_Moving_Heart__Querying.summary: M Taimur S Khan's 'A Moving Heart' is an ethnographic work on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Studies of mental health of Afghans tend to uncritically reflect the priority given to the trau- matic consequences of exposure to armed violence (Miller and Rasmussen 2009:8).' Field site: Peshawar Division. Published 2012 by Routledge.

Madiha_Tahir/Dispatches_from_Pakistan__3.title: Dispatches from Pakistan
Madiha_Tahir/Dispatches_from_Pakistan__3.author: Madiha Tahir
Madiha_Tahir/Dispatches_from_Pakistan__3.summary: Madiha Tahir, Vijay Prashad, and Qalandar Bux Memon's edited volume of essays from Pakistani journalists, scholars, and activists covering drone warfare, Karachi violence, women's rights, and class politics. Field sites: across Pakistan.

Magnus_Marsden/Fragments_of_the_Afghan_F.title: Fragments of the Afghan Frontier
Magnus_Marsden/Fragments_of_the_Afghan_F.author: Magnus Marsden
Magnus_Marsden/Fragments_of_the_Afghan_F.summary: Magnus Marsden and Benjamin Hopkins' Fragments of the Afghan Frontier reframes the Pakistan-Afghanistan borderland as an interconnected cultural region rather than a security periphery. Drawing on ethnography in Chitral, Gilgit-Baltistan, and Afghan-Tajik border areas, the book argues for plural histories of frontier life. Field sites: Chitral, Gilgit, eastern Afghanistan. Methodology: ethnographic fieldwork with archival history. Published 2011 by Hurst.

Magnus_Marsden/Muslim_village_intellectu.title: Muslim Village Intellectuals
Magnus_Marsden/Muslim_village_intellectu.author: Magnus Marsden
Magnus_Marsden/Muslim_village_intellectu.summary: Magnus Marsden's 'Muslim Village Intellectuals' is a religious-studies work on religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Aftab loved nothing more than voicing provocative statements before gatherings of the village’s youth (juanan) and sometimes, even, the respected elders (lilotan).' Field site: Chitrāl District. Published 2005 by Anthropology Today.

Magnus_Marsden/Talking_the_talk__Debatin.title: Talking the Talk: Debating Debate in Northern Afghanistan
Magnus_Marsden/Talking_the_talk__Debatin.author: Magnus Marsden
Magnus_Marsden/Talking_the_talk__Debatin.summary: Magnus Marsden's 'Talking the talk' is a religious-studies work on politics law and social organization and religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. Field site: Chitrāl District. Published 2009 by Anthropology Today.

Maleeha_Lodhi/Pakistan_Beyond_the_Crisis.title: Pakistan: Beyond the 'Crisis State'
Maleeha_Lodhi/Pakistan_Beyond_the_Crisis.author: Maleeha Lodhi
Maleeha_Lodhi/Pakistan_Beyond_the_Crisis.summary: Maleeha Lodhi's edited volume of policy-elite essays on Pakistan's structural challenges. Contributors include former civil servants, military officers, and academics. Field site: Pakistan, framed from Islamabad.

Maleeha_Lodhi/Pakistan__The_Search_for_S.title: Pakistan: The Search for Stability
Maleeha_Lodhi/Pakistan__The_Search_for_S.author: Maleeha Lodhi
Maleeha_Lodhi/Pakistan__The_Search_for_S.summary: Maleeha Lodhi's edited volume on Pakistan's recurring political and economic instabilities, with chapters by Pakistani policy elites. Field site: Pakistan, with attention to Islamabad's policy circles.

Manan_Ahmed_Asif/A_Book_of_Conquest__The.title: A Book of Conquest
Manan_Ahmed_Asif/A_Book_of_Conquest__The.author: Manan Ahmed Asif
Manan_Ahmed_Asif/A_Book_of_Conquest__The.summary: Manan Ahmed Asif's revisionist study of the Chachnama — the eighth-century Persian text on Muslim Sindh — as a thirteenth-century work of political theory rather than a historical chronicle. Field site: Sindh, Pakistan.

Manan_Ahmed_Asif/the-loss-of-hindustan-t.title: The Loss of Hindustan: The Invention of India
Manan_Ahmed_Asif/the-loss-of-hindustan-t.author: Manan Ahmed Asif
Manan_Ahmed_Asif/the-loss-of-hindustan-t.summary: Manan Ahmed Asif's revisionist intellectual history arguing that the modern category of 'India' (Hindustan) was lost. Field sites: Multan, Chach.

Mariam_Abou_Zahab/Islamist_Networks__The.title: Islamist Networks: The Afghan-Pakistan Connection
Mariam_Abou_Zahab/Islamist_Networks__The.author: Mariam Abou Zahab
Mariam_Abou_Zahab/Islamist_Networks__The.summary: Mariam Abou Zahab and Olivier Roy's classic study of the Afghan-Pakistan jihadist connection, mapping how networks linked the Afghan jihad to Pakistani sectarian groups. Field sites: FATA, Afghanistan.

Mariam_Abou_Zahab/Pakistan__A_Kaleidosco.title: Pakistan: A Kaleidoscope of Islam
Mariam_Abou_Zahab/Pakistan__A_Kaleidosco.author: Mariam Abou Zahab
Mariam_Abou_Zahab/Pakistan__A_Kaleidosco.summary: Mariam Abou Zahab's collected essays on Pakistan's many Islams — Barelvi, Deobandi, Shi'a, Ahmadi, and Sufi — as practiced in Punjab, Sindh, and KPK. Field sites: Pakistani religious communities across all four provinces.

Mariam_Abou_Zahab/The_Imperial_Optic__Ma.title: The Imperial Optic
Mariam_Abou_Zahab/The_Imperial_Optic__Ma.author: Madiha Durrani
Mariam_Abou_Zahab/The_Imperial_Optic__Ma.summary: Mariam Abou Zahab's 'The Imperial Optic' is a religious-studies work on kinship, marriage, and family. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'This was especially critical during the ﬁrst year as they were already dealing with the typical ﬁrst-year-at-college changes, such as mov- ing into dorms, eating and sleeping on time, and managing their studies.' Field site: Khyber Agency. Published 2013 by Wiley.

Marta_Bolognani/Pakistan_and_Its_Diaspor.title: Pakistan and Its Diaspora
Marta_Bolognani/Pakistan_and_Its_Diaspor.author: Marta Bolognani
Marta_Bolognani/Pakistan_and_Its_Diaspor.summary: Marta Bolognani et al.'s edited volume on Pakistanis abroad — labor migrants in the Gulf, scholarly diasporas in Britain, and second-generation communities. Multidisciplinary methods, comparative scope. Field sites: Pakistan, UK, Gulf states.

Mary_Elaine_Hegland/Shi_a_Women_of_North.title: Shi a Women of Northwest Pakistan and Agency through Practice
Mary_Elaine_Hegland/Shi_a_Women_of_North.author: Mary Elaine Hegland
Mary_Elaine_Hegland/Shi_a_Women_of_North.summary: Mary Elaine Hegland's 1991 ethnography of Shi'a Muslim women's mourning rituals (majales) in Peshawar, NWFP. Through participant observation among Qizilbash, Pukhtun and Indian-immigrant Shi'a families during Moharram and Safar, Hegland argues that women re-employ male-centred Husein-Karbala ritual to build skill, self-esteem and networks, contesting their subordination in a strict purdah society without openly challenging religion or family. Conducted under a Fulbright; partially evacuated during the Gulf War. Field site: Peshawar, North-West Frontier Province, Pakistan. Published in PoLAR: Political and Legal Anthropology Review, 1995.

Masooda_Bano/Breakdown_in_Pakistan__How_.title: Breakdown in Pakistan: How Aid Is Eroding Institutions for Collective Action
Masooda_Bano/Breakdown_in_Pakistan__How_.author: Masooda Bano
Masooda_Bano/Breakdown_in_Pakistan__How_.summary: Masooda Bano's analysis of how aid is eroding Pakistani institutions for collective action. Field sites: Anantnag, Rawalpindi, Bahawalpur.

Masooda_Bano/The_Rational_Believer__Choi.title: The Rational Believer: Choices and Decisions in the Madrasas of Pakistan
Masooda_Bano/The_Rational_Believer__Choi.author: Masooda Bano
Masooda_Bano/The_Rational_Believer__Choi.summary: Masooda Bano's ethnography of madrasa choice and decision-making in Pakistan, drawing on extensive interviews in Punjab and Karachi madrasas. Argues that madrasa attendance reflects rational pragmatic choices rather than ideological capture. Field sites: Lahore, Karachi madrasas.

Matthew_McCartney/New_Perspectives_on_Pa.title: New Perspectives on Pakistan's Political Economy
Matthew_McCartney/New_Perspectives_on_Pa.author: Matthew McCartney
Matthew_McCartney/New_Perspectives_on_Pa.summary: Matthew McCartney and S. Akbar Zaidi's edited volume reframing Pakistan's political economy through state, class, and social-change lenses. Cambridge University Press. Field site: Pakistan.

Matthew_McCartney/Pakistan_-_The_Politic.title: Pakistan: The Political Economy of Growth, Stagnation and the State, 1951-2009
Matthew_McCartney/Pakistan_-_The_Politic.author: Matthew McCartney
Matthew_McCartney/Pakistan_-_The_Politic.summary: Matthew McCartney's reassessment of Pakistan's economic development from 1951 to 2009, contesting the orthodox view that liberalisation has driven growth and instead placing the state and political conflict at the centre. Using a rigorous statistical methodology to define episodes of growth and stagnation, McCartney examines the state's role in resource mobilisation, productive allocation, and conflict management across successive military and civilian regimes. Methodology: quantitative political economy combined with policy history. Field site: Pakistan as a whole, with attention to Punjab and Karachi. Published Routledge Studies in the Growth Economies of Asia, 2011.

Matthew_Nelson/Islamic_Education_in_Bang.title: Islamic Education in Bangladesh and Pakistan
Matthew_Nelson/Islamic_Education_in_Bang.author: Matthew Nelson
Matthew_Nelson/Islamic_Education_in_Bang.summary: Matthew J. Nelson's comparative study of madrasa education in Bangladesh and Pakistan. Field sites: Bangladesh, Pakistan, Peshawar.

Matthias_Weinreich/We_Are_Here_to_Stay__.title: We Are Here to Stay: Pashtun Migrants in the Northern Areas of Pakistan
Matthias_Weinreich/We_Are_Here_to_Stay__.author: Matthias Weinreich
Matthias_Weinreich/We_Are_Here_to_Stay__.summary: Matthias Weinreich's ethnography of Pashtun migrants settled in Pakistan's Northern Areas (Gilgit-Baltistan), examining displacement, language shift, and identity. Field sites: Gilgit, Hunza, Chitral.

May_Schinasi/Kabul__A_History_1773-1948_.title: Kabul: A History 1773-1948
May_Schinasi/Kabul__A_History_1773-1948_.author: May Schinasi
May_Schinasi/Kabul__A_History_1773-1948_.summary: May Schinasi's longue-durée history of Kabul from the late Durrani founding through the end of the Musahiban dynasty. Field site: Kabul city. Combines Persian-language chronicles, French and British colonial archives, and architectural surveys to reconstruct the city's evolving urban form, population, neighborhoods, bazaars, royal precincts, and infrastructure. Brill, 2016 (English translation of the 2008 French original).

Michael_J_Casimir/Culture_and_the_Changi.title: Culture and the Changing Environment: Uncertainty, Cognition, and Risk Management in Cross-Cultural Perspective
Michael_J_Casimir/Culture_and_the_Changi.author: Michael J. Casimir
Michael_J_Casimir/Culture_and_the_Changi.summary: Michael J Casimir's 'Culture and the Changing Environment' is a bibliographic monograph on economics and subsistence. Regional focus: Pakistan. Field site: Ladākh. Published 2008 by Berghahn.

Michael_J_Casimir/Floating_Economies__Th.title: Floating Economies
Michael_J_Casimir/Floating_Economies__Th.author: Michael J. Casimir
Michael_J_Casimir/Floating_Economies__Th.summary: Michael J. Casimir's cultural ecology of Kashmir's Dal Lake — its houseboat communities, vegetable gardens, and the lake's slow ecological deterioration. Field site: Dal Lake, Srinagar.

Mohammad_Qadeer/Pakistan__Social_and_Cul.title: Pakistan: Social and Cultural Transformations in a Muslim Nation
Mohammad_Qadeer/Pakistan__Social_and_Cul.author: Mohammad Qadeer
Mohammad_Qadeer/Pakistan__Social_and_Cul.summary: Mohammad Qadeer's analysis of Pakistan's urbanization, demographic change, and cultural transformation since 1947. Field sites: Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad.

Mohammad_Waseem/Political_Conflict_in_Pa.title: Political Conflict in Pakistan
Mohammad_Waseem/Political_Conflict_in_Pa.author: Mohammad Waseem
Mohammad_Waseem/Political_Conflict_in_Pa.summary: Mohammad Waseem's Political Conflict in Pakistan is a comprehensive political-science analysis of Pakistani conflict patterns — civil-military relations, ethno-nationalism, sectarianism, and Islamism — drawing on decades of work at Quaid-i-Azam University. Field sites: pan-Pakistan; institutional analysis. Methodology: political science synthesis. Published 2021 by Hurst.

Muhammad_Anwar/Pakistan_Insight_s_Into_I.title: Pakistan Insight's Into Its Geography And Economy
Muhammad_Anwar/Pakistan_Insight_s_Into_I.author: Mohammad Anwar
Muhammad_Anwar/Pakistan_Insight_s_Into_I.summary: Mohammad Anwar's geographical and economic textbook on Pakistan — provincial-level geography, climate, agriculture, industry, and demographics. Field site: Pakistan.
Muhammad_Anwar/Pakistan_Insight_s_Into_I.original_title_pre_normalize: Pakistan Insight s Into Its Geography And Economy By Mohammad Anwar

Muhammad_Arif/Water_Resources_of_Pakista.title: Water Resources of Pakistan
Muhammad_Arif/Water_Resources_of_Pakista.author: Muhammad Arif Watto
Muhammad_Arif/Water_Resources_of_Pakista.summary: Muhammad Arif et al.'s edited volume on water-resources issues in Pakistan. Field sites: Indus basin, Pakistani Punjab.

Muhammad_Hamayun/Ethnobotanical_Profile_.title: Ethnobotanical Profile of Utror and Gabral Valleys, District Swat, Pakistan
Muhammad_Hamayun/Ethnobotanical_Profile_.author: Muhammad Hamayun
Muhammad_Hamayun/Ethnobotanical_Profile_.summary: Muhammad Hamayun et al.'s ethnobotanical survey of the Utror and Gabral valleys in Swat. Field sites: upper Swat, Malakand, KPK.

Muhammad_Hamayun/Studies_on_the_Traditio.title: Studies on the Traditional Uses of Some Medicinal Shrubs of Swat Kohistan
Muhammad_Hamayun/Studies_on_the_Traditio.author: Muhammad Hamayun
Muhammad_Hamayun/Studies_on_the_Traditio.summary: Muhammad Hamayun's 'Studies on the Traditional Uses of Some Medicinal Shrubs of Swat Kohistan' is an ethnographic monograph on the body, health, and life cycle. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Local uses Berberidaceae Berberis lycium Royle Rhizome and The rhizome is used locally for body and bones pain .' Field site: Swat Kohistan. Published 2006.

Muhammad_Latif/History_of_the_Punjab_fro.title: History of the Punjab from the Remotest Antiquity to the Present Time
Muhammad_Latif/History_of_the_Punjab_fro.author: Syad Muhammad Latif
Muhammad_Latif/History_of_the_Punjab_fro.summary: Muhammad Latif's historical compendium covering Punjab from antiquity to the late nineteenth century — Mughal, Sikh, and early colonial periods. Field site: undivided Punjab.

Muhammad_Shabir/Naseem_Hijazi_-_An_Uncel.title: Naseem Hijazi: An Uncelebrated Hero of the Pakistan Movement
Muhammad_Shabir/Naseem_Hijazi_-_An_Uncel.author: Muhammad Shabir
Muhammad_Shabir/Naseem_Hijazi_-_An_Uncel.summary: Muhammad Shabir's 'Naseem Hijazi - An Uncelebrated Hero of the Pakistan Movement' is a historical monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Naseem Hejazi was endeavoring for creating awareness about the Pakistan Movement in Baluchistan people.' Field site: Quetta Division. Published 2015.

Muhammad_Zafar/Medicinal_Plant_Biodivers.title: Medicinal Plant Biodiversity of Lesser Himalayas-Pakistan
Muhammad_Zafar/Medicinal_Plant_Biodivers.author: Muhammad Zafar
Muhammad_Zafar/Medicinal_Plant_Biodivers.summary: Arshad Mehmood Abbasi, Mir Ajab Khan, Mushtaq Ahmad and Muhammad Zafar's botanical and ethnobotanical inventory of 100 medicinal plant species — pteridophytes, gymnosperms, monocots and dicots — from the Lesser Himalayan range of northern Pakistan. Each species entry includes a scientific description, distribution, traditional medicinal use, and notes on anthropogenic pressures (fire, browsing, grazing, lopping, agriculture). Methodology: ethnobotanical fieldwork combined with herbarium-based plant taxonomy. Field site: Lesser Himalayas of northern Pakistan, including Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Azad Kashmir foothills. Published Springer, New York, 2012.

Murad_Ali/The_Politics_of_US_Aid_to_Paki.title: The Politics of US Aid to Pakistan
Murad_Ali/The_Politics_of_US_Aid_to_Paki.author: Murad Ali
Murad_Ali/The_Politics_of_US_Aid_to_Paki.summary: Murad Ali's analysis of US aid allocation and delivery to Pakistan from the Cold War through the post-9/11 era. Field site: Pakistan, with attention to the federal aid pipeline.

Myron_Weiner/The_Politics_of_Social_Tran.title: The Politics of Social Transformation in Afghanistan, Iran, and Pakistan
Myron_Weiner/The_Politics_of_Social_Tran.author: Myron Weiner
Myron_Weiner/The_Politics_of_Social_Tran.summary: Myron Weiner and edited contributors on social transformation in Afghanistan and Iran. Field site: Afghanistan.

Myron_Weiner/The_State__Religion_And_Eth.title: The State
Myron_Weiner/The_State__Religion_And_Eth.author: Myron Weiner
Myron_Weiner/The_State__Religion_And_Eth.summary: Myron Weiner and Ali Banuazizi's classic edited volume on state-religion-ethnicity in Pakistan, Iran, and Afghanistan. Field sites: Pakistan, Iran, Afghanistan.

Nadia_Agha/Kinship__Patriarchal_Structur.title: Kinship, Patriarchal Structure and Women's Bargaining with Patriarchy in Rural Sindh, Pakistan
Nadia_Agha/Kinship__Patriarchal_Structur.author: Nadia Agha
Nadia_Agha/Kinship__Patriarchal_Structur.summary: Nadia Agha's ethnography of women's bargaining within patriarchal kinship structures in rural Sindh. Field site: Khairpur and rural Sindh, Pakistan.

Najeeb_A_Jan/THE_METACOLONIAL_STATE__PAK.title: The Metacolonial State: Pakistan, Critical Ontology, and the Biopolitical Horizons of Political Islam
Najeeb_A_Jan/THE_METACOLONIAL_STATE__PAK.author: Najeeb A. Jan
Najeeb_A_Jan/THE_METACOLONIAL_STATE__PAK.summary: Najeeb A. Jan's intellectual-historical study of Pakistan's Deobandi 'ulama and the metacolonial state. Examines the formation of religious authority across British India and post-Partition Pakistan. Field sites: Deoband, Lahore, Karachi.

Nancy_Hatch_Dupree/An_Historical_Guide_T.title: An Historical Guide To Afghanistan
Nancy_Hatch_Dupree/An_Historical_Guide_T.author: Nancy Hatch Dupree
Nancy_Hatch_Dupree/An_Historical_Guide_T.summary: Nancy Hatch Dupree's classic guide to Afghanistan's archaeological and cultural sites, written before the Soviet invasion. Field site: Afghanistan.

Nancy_Lindisfarne_Tapper/Afghan_Village_.title: Afghan Village Voices: Stories from a Tribal Community
Nancy_Lindisfarne_Tapper/Afghan_Village_.author: Nancy Lindisfarne Tapper
Nancy_Lindisfarne_Tapper/Afghan_Village_.summary: Nancy Lindisfarne-Tapper and Richard Tapper's stories from a tribal Afghan community based on their decades of fieldwork in northern Afghanistan. Field sites: northern Afghanistan, Khalifa.

Nancy_Tapper/Bartered_Brides__Politics__.title: Bartered Brides
Nancy_Tapper/Bartered_Brides__Politics__.author: Nancy Tapper
Nancy_Tapper/Bartered_Brides__Politics__.summary: Nancy Tapper's classic ethnography of marriage as a political institution in an Afghan tribal community. Field sites: northern Afghanistan, Hazara, Mazar-i-Sharif.

Nasir_Ahmad/Neutrality_and_Vulnerable_St.title: Neutrality and Vulnerable States: An Analysis of Afghanistan's Permanent Neutrality
Nasir_Ahmad/Neutrality_and_Vulnerable_St.author: Nasir Ahmad Andisha
Nasir_Ahmad/Neutrality_and_Vulnerable_St.summary: Nasir Ahmad's 'Neutrality and Vulnerable States' is a historical monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Afghanistan. From the opening: 'Afghan Modern Diplomacy: The Role of Allama Mahmoud Tarzi and Mohammad Vali Khan Darvazi”.' Field site: Wakkan Corridor. Published 2010 by Cambridge University Press.

Naveed_Ahmed/Economic_Impacts_of_the_201.title: Economic Impacts of the 2010 Floods in North Sindh
Naveed_Ahmed/Economic_Impacts_of_the_201.author: Naveed Ahmed
Naveed_Ahmed/Economic_Impacts_of_the_201.summary: Naveed Ahmed's economic analysis of the 2010 Pakistan floods in north Sindh. Field site: Kandhkot, Jacobabad, Sindh.

Neamatollah_Nojumi/After_the_Taliban__li.title: After the Taliban
Neamatollah_Nojumi/After_the_Taliban__li.author: Neamatollah Nojumi
Neamatollah_Nojumi/After_the_Taliban__li.summary: Neamatollah Nojumi's account of life and security in rural Afghanistan after the 2001 fall of the Taliban. Combines field interviews with survey research across Afghan provinces during the early ISAF era. Field sites: rural Afghanistan, especially Kabul, Wardak, and Kandahar.

Niamatullah_Ibrahimi/Afghanistan__Politi.title: Afghanistan Politics and Economics in a Globalising State
Niamatullah_Ibrahimi/Afghanistan__Politi.author: Niamatullah Ibrahimi
Niamatullah_Ibrahimi/Afghanistan__Politi.summary: Niamatullah Ibrahimi's analysis of Afghan political economy in a globalising state, with attention to the Hazara, Tajik, Pashtun, and Uzbek dimensions. Field site: Afghanistan.

Niamatullah_Ibrahimi/The_Hazaras_and_the.title: The Hazaras and the Afghan State: Rebellion, Exclusion and the Struggle for Recognition
Niamatullah_Ibrahimi/The_Hazaras_and_the.author: Niamatullah Ibrahimi
Niamatullah_Ibrahimi/The_Hazaras_and_the.summary: Niamatullah Ibrahimi's The Hazaras and the Afghan State traces the political history of Afghanistan's Hazara minority from Abdur Rahman's late-19th-century campaigns through the post-2001 reconstruction era. Drawing on Persian and Pashto primary sources and oral history with Hazara elders, the book argues that exclusion has been constitutive of modern Afghan state-building. Field sites: Hazarajat (Bamyan, Daikundi, Ghazni), Kabul. Methodology: historical and oral history research. Published 2017 by Hurst.

Nichola_Khan/Arc_of_the_Journeyman__Afgh.title: Arc of the Journeyman
Nichola_Khan/Arc_of_the_Journeyman__Afgh.author: Nichola Khan
Nichola_Khan/Arc_of_the_Journeyman__Afgh.summary: Nichola Khan's ethnography of Afghan migrants in Sussex, England. Field sites: UK, Afghan migration corridors.

Nichola_Khan/Mohajir_Militancy_in_Pakist.title: Mohajir Militancy in Pakistan: Violence and Transformation in the Karachi Conflict
Nichola_Khan/Mohajir_Militancy_in_Pakist.author: Nichola Khan
Nichola_Khan/Mohajir_Militancy_in_Pakist.summary: Nichola Khan's ethnography of Mohajir political violence in Karachi, drawing on extensive interviews with MQM activists. Field site: Karachi, Pakistan.

Nicolas_Martin/Politics__Landlords_and_I.title: Politics, Landlords and Islam in Pakistan
Nicolas_Martin/Politics__Landlords_and_I.author: Nicolas Martin
Nicolas_Martin/Politics__Landlords_and_I.summary: Nicolas Martin's ethnography of rural Punjab politics — how landlord patronage and Islamic piety intersect at the village level. Field site: rural Punjab, Pakistan.

Niloufer_Siddiqui/Pakistan_s_Political_P.title: Pakistan's Political Parties
Niloufer_Siddiqui/Pakistan_s_Political_P.author: Niloufer A. Siddiqui
Niloufer_Siddiqui/Pakistan_s_Political_P.summary: Mariam Mufti, Sahar Shafqat, and Niloufer Siddiqui's edited volume on how Pakistani political parties (PPP, PML-N, PTI, MQM, JUI) navigate dictatorship, democracy, and patronage. Field site: Pakistan.

Niloufer_Siddiqui/Under_the_Gun__Politic.title: Under the Gun: Political Parties and Violence in Pakistan
Niloufer_Siddiqui/Under_the_Gun__Politic.author: Niloufer A. Siddiqui
Niloufer_Siddiqui/Under_the_Gun__Politic.summary: Niloufer Siddiqui's analysis of how Pakistani political parties (MQM, PPP, ANP, PML-N) deploy violence as a political tool. Drawing on field interviews and electoral data. Field sites: Karachi, Lahore, Peshawar.

Nivi_Manchanda/Imagining_Afghanistan___t.title: Imagining Afghanistan: The History and Politics of Imperial Knowledge
Nivi_Manchanda/Imagining_Afghanistan___t.author: Nivi Manchanda
Nivi_Manchanda/Imagining_Afghanistan___t.summary: Nivi Manchanda's Imagining Afghanistan analyzes how Western scholarly and popular knowledge has constructed Afghanistan as a tribal, ungovernable space, tracing this imaginary from 19th-century British imperial writing through 21st-century counterinsurgency analysis. The book combines critical international relations theory with archival reading. Field sites: textual and archival; Afghanistan as object of knowledge. Methodology: critical genealogy of imperial knowledge. Published 2020 by Cambridge University Press.

Noor_Elahi/Peacebuilding_through_Develop.title: Peacebuilding through Development Aid Projects
Noor_Elahi/Peacebuilding_through_Develop.author: Noor Elahi
Noor_Elahi/Peacebuilding_through_Develop.summary: Noor Elahi's analysis of peace-building through development aid in Pakistan's tribal areas. Field sites: Waziristan, South Waziristan.

Nosheen_Ali/Delusional_States__Feeling_R.title: Delusional States: Feeling Rule and Development in Pakistan's Northern Frontier
Nosheen_Ali/Delusional_States__Feeling_R.author: Nosheen Ali
Nosheen_Ali/Delusional_States__Feeling_R.summary: Nosheen Ali's Delusional States is an ethnography of state-formation, sectarian politics, and developmentalism in Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, arguing that Pakistani sovereignty in the region is sustained through affective regimes of 'feeling rule.' Ali draws on long-term fieldwork in Gilgit, Skardu, and surrounding valleys. Field sites: Gilgit, Skardu, Hunza, Astore. Methodology: ethnographic fieldwork. Published 2019 by Cambridge University Press.

Nosheen_Ali/Poetry__Power__Protest__Reim.title: Poetry, Power, Protest: Reimagining Muslim Nationhood in Northern Pakistan
Nosheen_Ali/Poetry__Power__Protest__Reim.author: Nosheen Ali
Nosheen_Ali/Poetry__Power__Protest__Reim.summary: Nosheen Ali's analysis of Urdu and Shina poetry as a vehicle for political dissent in Pakistan's Northern Areas (Gilgit-Baltistan). Field site: Gilgit, Hunza.

Olaf_Caroe/The_Pathans___550_B.C.-A.D._1.title: The Pathans: 550 B.C. - A.D.
Olaf_Caroe/The_Pathans___550_B.C.-A.D._1.author: Olaf Caroe
Olaf_Caroe/The_Pathans___550_B.C.-A.D._1.summary: Olaf Caroe's The Pathans is the foundational colonial-era synthesis of Pashtun history from Achaemenid Persia through the early Pakistani state, written by the last British Governor of NWFP. Caroe argues that Pashtun history is best understood as a continuous frontier civilization between Iranian and Indic worlds. Field sites: NWFP (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), tribal areas, eastern Afghanistan. Methodology: historical synthesis with administrative experience. Published 1958 by Macmillan.

Paul_Titus/KNIGHTS__NOT_PAWNS__ETHNO-NAT.title: Knights, Not Pawns: Ethno-Nationalism and Regional Dynamics in Post-Colonial Balochistan
Paul_Titus/KNIGHTS__NOT_PAWNS__ETHNO-NAT.author: Paul Titus
Paul_Titus/KNIGHTS__NOT_PAWNS__ETHNO-NAT.summary: Paul Titus's article on Baloch ethno-nationalism and regional politics in post-colonial Pakistan. Field site: Balochistan (Quetta and tribal districts). Argues that Baloch leaders have been knights of a regional political game, not pawns of Islamabad — using ethnic nationalism strategically against the Pakistani state. Published in Asian Survey (May/June 2000).

Paul_Titus/Marginality_and_Modernity__Et.title: Marginality and Modernity: Ethnicity and Change in Post-Colonial Balochistan
Paul_Titus/Marginality_and_Modernity__Et.author: Paul Titus
Paul_Titus/Marginality_and_Modernity__Et.summary: Paul Titus's edited volume on ethnic identity and change in post-colonial Balochistan, with chapters on Baloch tribes, Brahui speakers, and Hazara communities. Field site: Balochistan, Pakistan.
