Peter_Marsden/Afghanistan_Aid__Armies_an.title: Afghanistan: Aid, Armies and Empires
Peter_Marsden/Afghanistan_Aid__Armies_an.author: Peter Marsden
Peter_Marsden/Afghanistan_Aid__Armies_an.summary: Peter Marsden's history of aid, militaries, and empires in Afghanistan from the Soviet era through the post-2001 reconstruction. Field site: Afghanistan.

Philip_Carl_Salzman/Culture_and_Conflict.title: Culture and Conflict in the Middle East 1st
Philip_Carl_Salzman/Culture_and_Conflict.author: Philip Carl Salzman
Philip_Carl_Salzman/Culture_and_Conflict.summary: Philip Carl Salzman's essays on culture and conflict in the Middle East. Field sites: Middle East — Baluch, Khash.

Piotr_Balcerowicz/Human_Rights_Violation.title: Human Rights Violations in Kashmir
Piotr_Balcerowicz/Human_Rights_Violation.author: Piotr Balcerowicz
Piotr_Balcerowicz/Human_Rights_Violation.summary: Piotr Balcerowicz and Agnieszka Kuszewska's Human Rights Violations in Kashmir documents violations under Indian and Pakistani administration of the disputed territory, drawing on their long-term Kashmir fieldwork and on international legal frameworks. Field sites: Srinagar, Jammu, Muzaffarabad, Gilgit. Methodology: human-rights documentation with legal analysis. Published 2022 by Routledge.

Piotr_Balcerowicz/Kashmir_in_India_and_P.title: Kashmir in India and Pakistan Policies 29
Piotr_Balcerowicz/Kashmir_in_India_and_P.author: Piotr Balcerowicz
Piotr_Balcerowicz/Kashmir_in_India_and_P.summary: Piotr Balcerowicz's analysis of Indian and Pakistani policies on Kashmir over the last seven decades. Field sites: Indian-administered J&K, Pakistan-administered Azad Kashmir.

Piotr_Balcerowicz/Law_And_Conflict_Resol.title: Law and Conflict Resolution in Kashmir
Piotr_Balcerowicz/Law_And_Conflict_Resol.author: Piotr Balcerowicz
Piotr_Balcerowicz/Law_And_Conflict_Resol.summary: Piotr Balcerowicz and Agnieszka Kuszewska's legal-political study of conflict resolution in Kashmir. Field sites: Indian-administered J&K, Gilgit-Baltistan.

Piotr_Balcerowicz/Law_and_Conﬂict_Resolu.title: Law and Conﬂict Resolution in Kashmir
Piotr_Balcerowicz/Law_and_Conﬂict_Resolu.author: Piotr Balcerowicz
Piotr_Balcerowicz/Law_and_Conﬂict_Resolu.summary: Piotr Balcerowicz's legal analysis of Kashmir conflict resolution, focusing on international law mechanisms and proposed frameworks. Field sites: Indian-administered J&K, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan-administered Azad Kashmir.

Pippa_Virdee/From_the_Ashes_of_1947__Rei.title: From the Ashes of 1947: Reimagining Punjab
Pippa_Virdee/From_the_Ashes_of_1947__Rei.author: Pippa Virdee
Pippa_Virdee/From_the_Ashes_of_1947__Rei.summary: Pippa Virdee's history of Punjab from Partition to the present, reimagining Punjabi identity across the Indo-Pakistani border. Field sites: Punjab — Lahore, Amritsar, Faisalabad.

Pippa_Virdee/Pakistan__09757667f8219a4b1.title: THE ABRAHAMIC RELIGIONS Charles L. Cohen
Pippa_Virdee/Pakistan__09757667f8219a4b1.author: Pippa Virdee
Pippa_Virdee/Pakistan__09757667f8219a4b1.summary: Pippa Virdee's history of Pakistan since 1947, treating Partition as a long, ongoing rupture rather than a closed event. Foregrounds women's experiences, Punjab and Sindh regional histories, and the everyday textures of citizenship in a postcolonial state.

Qaisar_Abbas/From_Terrorism_to_Televisio.title: From Terrorism to Television: Dynamics of Media, State, and Society in Pakistan
Qaisar_Abbas/From_Terrorism_to_Televisio.author: Qaisar Abbas
Qaisar_Abbas/From_Terrorism_to_Televisio.summary: Farooq Sulehria and Qaisar Abbas's edited volume on dynamics of media, state, and society in Pakistan from the dictator-era PTV to the post-2002 private-channel boom. Field site: Pakistan.

Raghbir_Singh/Committee_on_Second_Five_Y.title: Committee on Second Five Year Plan
Raghbir_Singh/Committee_on_Second_Five_Y.author: Raghbir Singh
Raghbir_Singh/Committee_on_Second_Five_Y.summary: Raghbir Singh's 'Committee on Second Five Year Plan' is an other monograph on subject_unknown. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Wednesday, the 11th July, 1956, in the Central Hall under the Chair¬ manship of Shri R.' Field site: Ambar. Published 1956.

Raj_Wali_Shah_Khattak/Introduction_To_Pa.title: Introduction To Pashtun Culture
Raj_Wali_Shah_Khattak/Introduction_To_Pa.author: Raj Wali Shah Khattak
Raj_Wali_Shah_Khattak/Introduction_To_Pa.summary: Raj Wali Shah Khattak's overview of Pashtun cultural traditions. Field sites: KPK, Peshawar.

Rajshree_Jetly/Pakistan_in_Regional_and_.title: Pakistan in Regional and Global Politics
Rajshree_Jetly/Pakistan_in_Regional_and_.author: Rajshree Jetly
Rajshree_Jetly/Pakistan_in_Regional_and_.summary: Rajshree Jetly's edited volume on Pakistan's foreign policy and regional relationships. Field site: Pakistan, with attention to the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor.

Rakesh_Ankit/The_Kashmir_Conflict__From_.title: The Kashmir Conflict
Rakesh_Ankit/The_Kashmir_Conflict__From_.author: Rakesh Ankit
Rakesh_Ankit/The_Kashmir_Conflict__From_.summary: Rakesh Ankit's archival history of the Kashmir question from 1945 to 1966, drawing on declassified British, American, and Indian state records. Field site: J&K and Cold War diplomacy.

Raza_Rumi/Being_Pakistani__society__cult.title: Being Pakistani: Society, Culture and the Arts
Raza_Rumi/Being_Pakistani__society__cult.author: Raza Rumi
Raza_Rumi/Being_Pakistani__society__cult.summary: Raza Rumi's 'Being Pakistani' is a religious-studies monograph on religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'T hree decades ago, I asked Pakistan’s celebrated writer and intellectual Enver Sajjad to define Pakistani culture for me.' Field site: Sindh, Peshawar Division, Rawalpindi Division. Published 1947 by Penguin.

Raza_Rumi/Rethinking_Pakistan__A_21st_Ce.title: Rethinking Pakistan
Raza_Rumi/Rethinking_Pakistan__A_21st_Ce.author: Raza Rumi
Raza_Rumi/Rethinking_Pakistan__A_21st_Ce.summary: Raza Rumi's edited volume bringing together Pakistani writers, scholars, and policy thinkers to critically reassess the state at 75. Field site: Pakistan, written from a Lahore-Islamabad intellectual perspective.

Raza_Rumi/The_Fractious_Path__Pakistan_s.title: The Fractious Path: Pakistan's Democratic Transition
Raza_Rumi/The_Fractious_Path__Pakistan_s.author: Raza Rumi
Raza_Rumi/The_Fractious_Path__Pakistan_s.summary: Ishtiaq Ahmed and Adnan Rafiq's edited volume on Pakistan's democratic transitions and reversals. Field site: Pakistan.

Rehana_Wagha/War__Violence_and_Women_s_A.title: War, Violence and Women's Agency in Pakistan: The Case of Swat
Rehana_Wagha/War__Violence_and_Women_s_A.author: Rehana Wagha
Rehana_Wagha/War__Violence_and_Women_s_A.summary: Rehana Wagha's case study of women's agency under Taliban rule in Swat, drawing on field research with women who lived through the 2007-2009 occupation. Field site: Swat valley, Pakistan.

Riaz_Ahmad/All_India_Muslim_League_and_t.title: All India Muslim League and the Creation of Pakistan
Riaz_Ahmad/All_India_Muslim_League_and_t.author: Riaz Ahmad
Riaz_Ahmad/All_India_Muslim_League_and_t.summary: Riaz Ahmad's history of the All-India Muslim League's organizational role in the creation of Pakistan. Field sites: undivided Punjab, Peshawar, Quetta.

Richard_Tapper/Frontier_Nomads_Of_Iran_A.title: Frontier Nomads Of Iran A Political And Social History Of The Shahsevan
Richard_Tapper/Frontier_Nomads_Of_Iran_A.author: Richard Tapper
Richard_Tapper/Frontier_Nomads_Of_Iran_A.summary: Richard Tapper's classic political and social history of frontier nomads of Iran (the Shahsevan). Field sites: northwestern Iran — peripheral but relevant for Afghan tribe comparisons.
Richard_Tapper/Frontier_Nomads_Of_Iran_A.original_title_pre_normalize: Frontier Nomads Of Iran A Political And Social History Of The Shahsevan By Richard Tapper

Richard_Tapper/Frontier_nomads_of_Iran__.title: Frontier Nomads of Iran: A Political and Social History of the Shahsevan
Richard_Tapper/Frontier_nomads_of_Iran__.author: Richard Tapper
Richard_Tapper/Frontier_nomads_of_Iran__.summary: Richard Tapper's political and social history of the Shahsevan, a major Iranian nomadic confederacy on the sensitive Azarbaijan frontier with Russia. Drawing on three decades of ethnographic fieldwork and extensive Persian and Russian documentary research, Tapper traces the tribes' mythical Safavid origins, their eighteenth-century unification as a confederacy, and their dispossession under the Pahlavi Shahs. The book also intervenes in debates about how state relations shape tribal formations and how identity and historical memory shape one another. Field site: Moghan, Ardabil, Meshkin-Shahr and the Mt Savalan pastures of Iranian Azarbaijan. Published Cambridge University Press, 1997.

Richard_Tapper/Tribe_and_State_in_Iran_a.title: The Conflict of Tribe and State in Iran and Afghanistan
Richard_Tapper/Tribe_and_State_in_Iran_a.author: Richard Tapper
Richard_Tapper/Tribe_and_State_in_Iran_a.summary: Richard Tapper's edited volume Tribe and State in Iran and Afghanistan gathers comparative essays on pastoral and segmentary tribal organization across the Iranian-Afghan plateau, including chapters on Hazara, Aimaq, Pashtun, and Baluch societies. Field sites: Iranian and Afghan tribal regions. Methodology: edited comparative ethnography. Published 1983 by Croom Helm.

Robert_G_Wirsing/Kashmir_in_the_Shadow_o.title: Kashmir in the Shadow of War: Regional Rivalries in a Nuclear Age
Robert_G_Wirsing/Kashmir_in_the_Shadow_o.author: Robert Wirsing
Robert_G_Wirsing/Kashmir_in_the_Shadow_o.summary: Robert G. Wirsing's strategic analysis of the Kashmir conflict in the nuclear-rivalry era, examining how India and Pakistan have managed (or failed to manage) the dispute since 1998. Field site: South Asia, with focus on the Line of Control.

Robert_Nichols/A_History_of_Pashtun_Migr.title: A History of Pashtun Migration, 1775-2006
Robert_Nichols/A_History_of_Pashtun_Migr.author: Robert Nichols
Robert_Nichols/A_History_of_Pashtun_Migr.summary: Robert Nichols's history of Pashtun migration from 1775 to 2006 — labor, trade, and forced displacement. Field site: Pashtun belt of Pakistan and Afghanistan.

Robert_Wirsing/Fixing_fractured_nations_.title: Fixing Fractured Nations: The Challenge of Ethnic Separatism in the Asia-Pacific
Robert_Wirsing/Fixing_fractured_nations_.author: Robert G. Wirsing
Robert_Wirsing/Fixing_fractured_nations_.summary: Robert Wirsing's Fixing Fractured Nations gathers comparative case studies of ethnic separatism in the Asia-Pacific, with extensive treatment of Kashmir, Balochistan, and Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa. Wirsing argues that durable settlements require federal accommodation rather than security suppression. Field sites: comparative; Kashmir and Pakistan as central cases. Methodology: comparative political analysis. Published 2010 by Palgrave Macmillan.

Robert_Wirsing/Imagining_Industan__Overc.title: Imagining Industan: Overcoming Water Insecurity in the Indus Basin
Robert_Wirsing/Imagining_Industan__Overc.author: Robert G. Wirsing
Robert_Wirsing/Imagining_Industan__Overc.summary: Robert G. Wirsing and edited contributors' analysis of water insecurity in the Indus basin and the geopolitics of upstream-downstream relations between India and Pakistan. Field site: Indus basin.

Robert_Wirsing/International_Conflict_ov.title: International Conflict over Water Resources in Himalayan Asia
Robert_Wirsing/International_Conflict_ov.author: Robert G. Wirsing
Robert_Wirsing/International_Conflict_ov.summary: Robert Wirsing's analysis of trans-Himalayan water conflicts. Field sites: Indus basin — Jammu, Anantnag.

Robert_Wirsing/SPOTLIGHT_ON_INDUS_RIVER_.title: Spotlight on Indus River Diplomacy: India, Pakistan, and the Baglihar Dam Dispute
Robert_Wirsing/SPOTLIGHT_ON_INDUS_RIVER_.author: Robert G. Wirsing
Robert_Wirsing/SPOTLIGHT_ON_INDUS_RIVER_.summary: Robert Wirsing's 'Spotlight on Indus River Diplomacy' is an other monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'India is moving steadily closer to a danger zone in terms of water supply.' Field site: Jammu. Published 2006.

Robin_Coningham/2015-jan_1__b90ca0875d88.title: The Archaeology of South Asia: From the Indus to Asoka, c.6500 BCE-200 CE
Robin_Coningham/2015-jan_1__b90ca0875d88.author: Robin Coningham
Robin_Coningham/2015-jan_1__b90ca0875d88.summary: Robin Coningham and Ruth Young's Cambridge World Archaeology synthesis of South Asian archaeology from the Neolithic (c. 6500 BCE) to Asoka's Mauryan empire (third century BCE). The volume gives equal weight to the Indus civilisation's urbanism and to rural-urban interactions, and reviews collapse, regionalisation, and the second urbanisation. Field sites: Mehrgarh, Harappa, Mohenjo-daro, Charsadda, Taxila, the Bannu basin, the Helmand basin, and Sri Lanka. Methodology: archaeological synthesis drawing on excavation reports, field photography, and stratigraphic chronologies. Published Cambridge University Press, 2015.

Robin_Coningham/Appropriating_the_Past__.title: Appropriating the Past
Robin_Coningham/Appropriating_the_Past__.author: Robin Coningham
Robin_Coningham/Appropriating_the_Past__.summary: Robin Coningham's 'Appropriating the Past' is an archaeological monograph on material culture and technology. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Archaeological Knowledge, Community Knowledge, and the Embracing of Conﬂict  Piotr Bienkowski  The Past People Want: Heritage for the Majority?.' Field site: Gambat, Harappa. by Cambridge University Press.

Robin_Coningham/Archaeology__Cultural_He.title: Archaeology, Cultural Heritage Protection and Community Engagement in South Asia
Robin_Coningham/Archaeology__Cultural_He.author: Robin Coningham
Robin_Coningham/Archaeology__Cultural_He.summary: Robin Coningham and Nick Lewer's edited Palgrave Pivot volume from Durham's UNESCO Chair in Archaeological Ethics and Practice, presenting case studies on community engagement in heritage protection across South Asia. Chapters by Shahnaj Husne Jahan (Bhitargarh, Bangladesh), K. Krishnan, Mahinda Deegalle (Kuragala, Sri Lanka), Lewer-Lafortune-Bernard-Coningham-Acharya-Kunwar (Lumbini's Dohani micro-heritage), Zahra Hussain (intangible heritage in Northern Pakistan), Rajendra Suwal (natural heritage in Nepal) and Kai Weise (Bagan, Myanmar) explore how local communities can drive sustainable site stewardship. Field sites: Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Pakistan, Myanmar. Published Springer Nature Singapore, 2019.

Robin_Coningham/The_Archaeology_of_South.title: The Archaeology of South Asia
Robin_Coningham/The_Archaeology_of_South.author: Robin Coningham
Robin_Coningham/The_Archaeology_of_South.summary: Robin Coningham and Ruth Young's textbook on the archaeology of South Asia from the Indus Civilization to Asoka. Field sites: Charsadda, Harappa.

Rosita_Armytage/Big_Capital_in_an_Unequa.title: Big Capital in an Unequal World
Rosita_Armytage/Big_Capital_in_an_Unequa.author: Rosita Armytage
Rosita_Armytage/Big_Capital_in_an_Unequa.summary: Rosita Armytage's ethnography of Pakistan's super-rich — the Punjabi industrial elite — drawing on extensive fieldwork in Lahore and Karachi. Examines how the wealthy navigate political instability while maintaining capital accumulation. Field sites: Lahore, Karachi.

Rosita_Armytage/The_Social_Lives_of_the_.title: The Social Lives of the Elite: Friendship and Power in Pakistan
Rosita_Armytage/The_Social_Lives_of_the_.author: Rosita Armytage
Rosita_Armytage/The_Social_Lives_of_the_.summary: Rosita Armytage's 'The Social Lives of the Elite' is an ethnographic work on kinship, marriage, and family and politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'The ﬁrst explores how elites foster affective relationships with other powerful and inﬂuential individuals in business, the bureaucracy, formal politics and the military through endogamous elite male socialising.' Field site: Anantnag. Published 2015.

S_Akbar_Zaidi/Issues_in_Pakistan_s_Econo.title: Issues in Pakistan's Economy: A Political Economy Perspective
S_Akbar_Zaidi/Issues_in_Pakistan_s_Econo.author: S. Akbar Zaidi
S_Akbar_Zaidi/Issues_in_Pakistan_s_Econo.summary: S. Akbar Zaidi's standard graduate-level reference text on the political economy of Pakistan from independence to the present. Covers agriculture, industry, fiscal policy, structural adjustment, and the country's economic history through successive military and civilian regimes.

S_Akbar_Zaidi/The_Dismal_State_of_the_So.title: The Dismal State of the Social Sciences in Pakistan
S_Akbar_Zaidi/The_Dismal_State_of_the_So.author: S. Akbar Zaidi
S_Akbar_Zaidi/The_Dismal_State_of_the_So.summary: S. Akbar Zaidi's critical analysis of the underdevelopment of social sciences in Pakistan. Field site: Pakistan.

Saadia_Toor/The_State_of_Islam__Culture_.title: The State of Islam
Saadia_Toor/The_State_of_Islam__Culture_.author: Saadia Toor
Saadia_Toor/The_State_of_Islam__Culture_.summary: Saadia Toor's history of culture and Cold War politics in Pakistan, examining how the state's anti-communist alignment reshaped its cultural and educational policies. Field site: Pakistan.

Sadaf_Ahmad/Pakistani_women___multiple_l.title: Pakistani Women: Multiple Locations and Competing Narratives
Sadaf_Ahmad/Pakistani_women___multiple_l.author: Sadaf Ahmad
Sadaf_Ahmad/Pakistani_women___multiple_l.summary: Sadaf Ahmad's edited volume on Pakistani women across multiple social locations and competing narratives. Field site: Pakistan.

Sadia_Saeed/Politics_Of_Desecularization.title: Politics Of Desecularization - Law and the minority question in Pakistan
Sadia_Saeed/Politics_Of_Desecularization.author: Sadia Saeed
Sadia_Saeed/Politics_Of_Desecularization.summary: Sadia Saeed's earlier book on the law and the minority question in Pakistan, particularly Ahmadi exclusion. Field site: Pakistan.

Sadia_Saeed/Politics_of_Desecularization.title: Politics of Desecularization: Law and the Minority Question in Pakistan
Sadia_Saeed/Politics_of_Desecularization.author: Sadia Saeed
Sadia_Saeed/Politics_of_Desecularization.summary: Sadia Saeed's study of how Pakistan's anti-Ahmadi laws and minority politics have evolved through judicial and political conflict. Field sites: Punjab and the Pakistani courts.

Sadia_Saeed/Politics_of_Exclusion__Musli.title: Politics of Exclusion
Sadia_Saeed/Politics_of_Exclusion__Musli.author: Sadia Saeed
Sadia_Saeed/Politics_of_Exclusion__Musli.summary: Sadia Saeed's history of Muslim nationalism, state formation, and the legal exclusion of Ahmadiyya Muslims from full Pakistani citizenship. Field site: Pakistan, especially Punjab.

Saeed_Ullah_Jan/USABILITY_AND_ACCESSIBIL.title: Usability and Accessibility of Internet by the University Students of Pakistan
Saeed_Ullah_Jan/USABILITY_AND_ACCESSIBIL.author: Saeed Ullah Jan
Saeed_Ullah_Jan/USABILITY_AND_ACCESSIBIL.summary: Saeed Ullah Jan's study of internet usability among Pakistani university students. Field sites: KPK, Karak, Peshawar, Khyber.

Salman_Hussain/Violence__Law__and_the_Ar.title: Violence, Law, and the Archive: How Dossiers of Memory Challenge Enforced Disappearances in the War on Terror in Pakistan
Salman_Hussain/Violence__Law__and_the_Ar.author: Salman Hussain
Salman_Hussain/Violence__Law__and_the_Ar.summary: Salman Hussain's article on violence, law, and the archive in Pakistan. Field sites: Rawalpindi, Quetta.

Samina_Ahmed/Pakistan_s_Nuclear_Weapons_.title: Pakistan's Nuclear Weapons Program: Turning Points and Nuclear Choices
Samina_Ahmed/Pakistan_s_Nuclear_Weapons_.author: Samina Ahmed
Samina_Ahmed/Pakistan_s_Nuclear_Weapons_.summary: Samina Ahmed's 'Pakistan's Nuclear Weapons Program' is an other monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'International Security 23:4 I 280 This article traces Pakistan’s nuclear history and attempts to identify the role of domestic, regional, and international variables in determining Pakistan’s nuclear choices.' Field site: Anantnag. Published 1999 by MIT Press.

Sana_Haroon/3___Religious_Revivalism_acr.title: Religious Revivalism across the Durand Line (chapter from Frontier of Faith / related book)
Sana_Haroon/3___Religious_Revivalism_acr.author: Sana Haroon
Sana_Haroon/3___Religious_Revivalism_acr.summary: Sana Haroon's 'Th rough the early twentieth century, the religious elites of Afghanistan' is a religious-studies monograph on religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Line Sana Haroon I n the early twentieth century Afghanistan became a rallying point for anticolonial nationalists in British India, and between 1985 and 2001 it again became a rallying point, this time for Pakistani religious politics.' Field site: Peshawar Division. Published 1985.

Sanaa_Alimia/Refugee_Cities__How_Afghans.title: Refugee Cities
Sanaa_Alimia/Refugee_Cities__How_Afghans.author: Sanaa Alimia
Sanaa_Alimia/Refugee_Cities__How_Afghans.summary: Sanaa Alimia's ethnography of how Afghan refugees have transformed urban Pakistan since the 1980s. Documents the everyday geographies of Pashto-speaking neighborhoods in Karachi and Peshawar, focusing on identification papers, infrastructure, and political belonging.

Sara_Rizvi/Social_Policy_for_Women_in_Pa.title: Social Policy for Women in Pakistan
Sara_Rizvi/Social_Policy_for_Women_in_Pa.author: Sara Rizvi Jafree
Sara_Rizvi/Social_Policy_for_Women_in_Pa.summary: Sara Rizvi Jafree's monograph on women-focused social policy in Pakistan. Field site: Pakistan.

Seema_Shekhawat/Gender__Conflict_and_Pea.title: Gender, Conflict and Peace in Kashmir: Invisible Stakeholders
Seema_Shekhawat/Gender__Conflict_and_Pea.author: Seema Shekhawat
Seema_Shekhawat/Gender__Conflict_and_Pea.summary: Seema Shekhawat's edited volume on women as 'invisible stakeholders' in the Kashmir conflict. Field site: Indian-administered J&K.

Shabana_Gul/Voices_of_the_Unvoiced__Wome.title: Voices of the Unvoiced: Women's Struggle for Education in Khyber Pukhtunkhwa, Pakistan
Shabana_Gul/Voices_of_the_Unvoiced__Wome.author: Shabana Shamaas Gul Khattak
Shabana_Gul/Voices_of_the_Unvoiced__Wome.summary: Shabana Gul's study of women's struggle for education in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, including the Malala Yousafzai era. Field site: KPK, Pakistan.

Shahrukh_Rafi_Khan/Social_Capital_and_Co.title: Social Capital and Collective Action in Pakistani Rural Development
Shahrukh_Rafi_Khan/Social_Capital_and_Co.author: Shahrukh Rafi Khan
Shahrukh_Rafi_Khan/Social_Capital_and_Co.summary: Shahrukh Rafi Khan's study of social capital and collective action in Hazara Division, Pakistan. Field site: Hazara Division, KPK.

Shahrukh_Rafi_Khan/The_Military_and_Deni.title: The Military and Denied Development in the Pakistani Punjab: An Eroding Social Consensus
Shahrukh_Rafi_Khan/The_Military_and_Deni.author: Shahrukh Rafi Khan
Shahrukh_Rafi_Khan/The_Military_and_Deni.summary: Shahrukh Rafi Khan's analysis of how Pakistani military involvement has crowded out development in southern Punjab. Field sites: Kasur, Bahawalnagar, Rahim Yar Khan.

Shandana_Khan/Crafty_Oligarchs__Savvy_Vo.title: Crafty Oligarchs
Shandana_Khan/Crafty_Oligarchs__Savvy_Vo.author: Shandana Khan Mohmand
Shandana_Khan/Crafty_Oligarchs__Savvy_Vo.summary: Shandana Khan Mohmand's ethnography of how Pakistani villagers vote under conditions of structural inequality. Drawing on extensive field research in rural Punjab. Field site: rural Punjab, Pakistan.

Sher_Ali/The_Changing_Perspective_of_Art.title: The Changing Perspective of Art Education in Pakistan
Sher_Ali/The_Changing_Perspective_of_Art.author: Muhammad Sher Ali Khan
Sher_Ali/The_Changing_Perspective_of_Art.summary: Sher Ali's 'The Changing Perspective of Art Education in Pakistan' is a historical monograph on art and symbolism. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Besides professional craftsmen, young students took a keen interest in the visual arts; many of whom became founder members of art institutions later on in their professional life.' Field site: Peshawar Division. Published 2014.

Shirin_Zubair/Not_Easily_Put-Downable___.title: Not Easily Put-Downable
Shirin_Zubair/Not_Easily_Put-Downable___.author: Shirin Zubair
Shirin_Zubair/Not_Easily_Put-Downable___.summary: Shirin Zubair's feminist discourse-analytic study of how Urdu women's magazines (Khwateen Digest, Shuaa, Pakeeza, Akhbar-e-Jehan) shape Muslim women's identities in Southern Punjab. Drawing on Lazar's Feminist Critical Discourse Analysis and Kress and van Leeuwen's social semiotics, alongside a 2006-07 questionnaire survey of readers in Multan, Zubair argues that the magazines articulate ambivalent identities that simultaneously serve patriarchy and offer readers idioms of pleasure and self-construction. Field site: Multan, Southern Punjab, Pakistan. Funded by Bahauddin Zakariya University; published in Feminist Formations, 2010.

Shubh_Mathur/Life__Politics__and_Resista.title: Life, Politics, and Resistance in Kashmir after
Shubh_Mathur/Life__Politics__and_Resista.author: Shubh Mathur
Shubh_Mathur/Life__Politics__and_Resista.summary: Shubh Mathur's edited volume on the political ethnography of Kashmir following the 2008 mass uprisings. Field site: Kashmir Valley. Brings together ethnographic accounts of life under militarization, half-widows, enforced disappearances, and youth resistance. Published by Lexington Books / Rowman & Littlefield.

Shubh_Mathur/The_Human_Toll_of_the_Kashm.title: The Human Toll of the Kashmir Conflict: Grief and Courage in a South Asian Borderland
Shubh_Mathur/The_Human_Toll_of_the_Kashm.author: Shubh Mathur
Shubh_Mathur/The_Human_Toll_of_the_Kashm.summary: Shubh Mathur's ethnography of grief and courage among Kashmiri families bereaved by the conflict, drawing on extensive fieldwork in the Valley. Field site: Kashmir Valley.

Stephen_Lyon/Challenging_the_landed_elit.title: Challenging the landed elite in contemporary Pakistani politics
Stephen_Lyon/Challenging_the_landed_elit.author: Stephen Lyon
Stephen_Lyon/Challenging_the_landed_elit.summary: Stephen Lyon's 'Challenging the landed elite in contemporary Pakistani politics' is an ethnographic work on kinship, marriage, and family and politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Lyon 42 predictability, without closing the possibility of future allegiances to cope with unexpected shocks.' Field site: Khyber Agency. Published 2019.

Sudhir_Kakar/Imaginations_of_Death_and_t.title: Imaginations of Death and the Beyond in India and Europe
Sudhir_Kakar/Imaginations_of_Death_and_t.author: Sudhir Kakar
Sudhir_Kakar/Imaginations_of_Death_and_t.summary: Sudhir Kakar's 'Imaginations of Death and the Beyond in India and Europe 1st ed' is an other monograph on art and symbolism. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Sudhir Kakar 2 Threshold Images Between Life and Death in Western Literature and Film .' Field site: Ghat. Published 2018 by Springer.

Sudhir_Kakar/On_Dreams_and_Dreaming__6a9.title: On Dreams and Dreaming
Sudhir_Kakar/On_Dreams_and_Dreaming__6a9.author: Sudhir Kakar
Sudhir_Kakar/On_Dreams_and_Dreaming__6a9.summary: Sudhir Kakar's 'On Dreams and Dreaming' is a religious-studies monograph on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Freudian psychoanalyst, a leading Jungian analyst and some of the world’s foremost scholars of dream studies to reflect on the phenomena of dreams and dreaming which have fascinated human beings through the ages and across all cultures.' Field site: Kahan. Published 2009.

Sudhir_Kakar/The_Inner_World__A_Psychoan.title: The Inner World
Sudhir_Kakar/The_Inner_World__A_Psychoan.author: Sudhir Kakar
Sudhir_Kakar/The_Inner_World__A_Psychoan.summary: Sudhir Kakar's 'The Inner World' is a historical monograph on kinship, marriage, and family. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'The importance of anthropological studies is that they ground generalizations based on psycho-analytic deductions in the everyday realities of a given culture.' Field site: Hera. Published 1981 by Oxford University Press.

Sumantra_Bose/Canine_counterinsurgency_i.title: Canine counterinsurgency in Indian-occupied Kashmir -- Critique of Anthropology
Sumantra_Bose/Canine_counterinsurgency_i.author: Sumantra Bose
Sumantra_Bose/Canine_counterinsurgency_i.summary: Sumantra Bose's article on canine units in counterinsurgency operations in Indian-administered Kashmir. Field sites: Srinagar, Jammu.

Sumantra_Bose/Contested_Lands__Israel-Pa.title: Contested Lands: Israel-Palestine, Kashmir, Bosnia, Cyprus, and Sri Lanka
Sumantra_Bose/Contested_Lands__Israel-Pa.author: Sumantra Bose
Sumantra_Bose/Contested_Lands__Israel-Pa.summary: Sumantra Bose's Contested Lands compares five long-running self-determination conflicts, with Kashmir treated alongside Israel-Palestine, Bosnia, Cyprus, and Sri Lanka. The Kashmir chapters trace the region's disputed sovereignty since 1947 and evaluate prospects for federated peace settlements. Field site: Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir; comparative material on other conflict zones. Methodology: comparative political analysis. Published 2007 by Harvard University Press.

Sumantra_Bose/Media_Propaganda_and_the_K.title: Media Propaganda and the Kashmir Dispute
Sumantra_Bose/Media_Propaganda_and_the_K.author: Sumantra Bose
Sumantra_Bose/Media_Propaganda_and_the_K.summary: Sumantra Bose's analysis of media propaganda in the Kashmir dispute. Field site: Indian-administered J&K.

Syed_Attaullah_Shah/Revisiting_the_Chron.title: Revisiting the Chronology of the Early Sculptural Art of Kashmir, India
Syed_Attaullah_Shah/Revisiting_the_Chron.author: Syed Attaullah Shah
Syed_Attaullah_Shah/Revisiting_the_Chron.summary: M.A. Shah's reassessment of the chronology of early sculptural art in the Kashmir valley, arguing that its terracotta and stucco fragments belong to the Kushan period rather than later, on the basis of recent excavations by B.R. Mani at Kanispur and Akhnur. The article re-reads finds from Ushkur (Baramulla), Harwan (Srinagar), Semthan (Anantnag) and Akhnur (Jammu) against Kalhana's Rajatarangini and earlier dating proposals by Fabri, Khandalavala and Kak. Methodology: comparative stylistic analysis combined with stratigraphic re-evaluation. Field sites: Ushkur, Harwan, Semthan, Akhnur. Published in Archaeology, Ethnology and Anthropology of Eurasia, 2014.

Syed_Irfan_Ashraf/The_dark_side_of_news_.title: The Dark Side of News Fixing: The Culture and Political Economy of Global Media in Pakistan and Afghanistan
Syed_Irfan_Ashraf/The_dark_side_of_news_.author: Syed Irfan Ashraf
Syed_Irfan_Ashraf/The_dark_side_of_news_.summary: Syed Irfan Ashraf's analysis of news fixing — the work of local Pakistani journalists who guide foreign correspondents — and its political economy in tribal Pakistan. Field sites: KPK, Peshawar, FATA.

Syed_Sami_Raza/Geopolitics_of_the_Pakist.title: Geopolitics of the Pakistan-Afghanistan Borderland
Syed_Sami_Raza/Geopolitics_of_the_Pakist.author: Syed Sami Raza
Syed_Sami_Raza/Geopolitics_of_the_Pakist.summary: Syed Sami Raza's analysis of the Pakistan-Afghanistan borderland geopolitics. Field sites: KPK, FATA, eastern Afghanistan.

Syed_Sami_Raza/The_Security_State_in_Pak.title: The Security State in Pakistan
Syed_Sami_Raza/The_Security_State_in_Pak.author: Syed Sami Raza
Syed_Sami_Raza/The_Security_State_in_Pak.summary: Syed Sami Raza's analysis of Pakistan's legal foundations as a security state. Field site: Pakistan.

Talal_Asad/Secular_Translations_N-State_.title: Secular Translations: Nation-State, Modern Self, and Calculative Reason
Talal_Asad/Secular_Translations_N-State_.author: Talal Asad
Talal_Asad/Secular_Translations_N-State_.summary: Talal Asad's reflections on secular translations between religious and modern political registers. Field site: comparative — South Asia and Middle East.

Talal_Asad/Secular_Translations__Nation-.title: Secular Translations: Nation-State, Modern Self, and Calculative Reason
Talal_Asad/Secular_Translations__Nation-.author: Talal Asad
Talal_Asad/Secular_Translations__Nation-.summary: Talal Asad's reflections on secular translations between religious and modern political registers. Field site: comparative — South Asia and Middle East.

Tariq_Rahman/Denizens_of_Alien_Worlds__A.title: Denizens of Alien Worlds
Tariq_Rahman/Denizens_of_Alien_Worlds__A.author: Tariq Rahman
Tariq_Rahman/Denizens_of_Alien_Worlds__A.summary: Tariq Rahman's study of education, inequality, and polarization in Pakistan — comparing English-medium elite schools, Urdu-medium government schools, and madrasas. Field site: Pakistani educational system.

Tariq_Rahman/Language__Ideology_and_Powe.title: Language Ideology and Power Language-learning among the Muslims of Pakistan and North India
Tariq_Rahman/Language__Ideology_and_Powe.author: Tariq Rahman
Tariq_Rahman/Language__Ideology_and_Powe.summary: Tariq Rahman's study of language-learning ideology and power among Muslims of Pakistan and India. Field sites: Pakistan, including Peshawar madrasas.

Tariq_Rahman/Language_and_Politics_in_Pa.title: Language and Politics in Pakistan
Tariq_Rahman/Language_and_Politics_in_Pa.author: Tariq Rahman
Tariq_Rahman/Language_and_Politics_in_Pa.summary: Tariq Rahman's classic study of language politics in Pakistan — Urdu, Punjabi, Sindhi, Pashto, Balochi, Saraiki — as flashpoints for ethnic mobilization and education policy. Field site: Pakistan.

Tariq_Rahman/Names__A_Study_of_Personal_.title: Identity, and Power in Pakistan
Tariq_Rahman/Names__A_Study_of_Personal_.author: Tariq Rahman
Tariq_Rahman/Names__A_Study_of_Personal_.summary: Tariq Rahman's study of personal names, identity, and power in Pakistan. Field sites: Pakistan — Rawalpindi, Peshawar.

Tariq_Rahman/Pakistan_s_Wars__An_Alterna.title: Pakistan's Wars: An Alternative History
Tariq_Rahman/Pakistan_s_Wars__An_Alterna.author: Tariq Rahman
Tariq_Rahman/Pakistan_s_Wars__An_Alterna.summary: Tariq Rahman's revisionist military history of Pakistan, examining the 1948, 1965, 1971, and Kargil wars from a critical perspective. Field site: Pakistan, with attention to the Indo-Pakistani borderlands.

Tariq_Rahman/Tariq_Rahman__From_Hindi_To.title: From Hindi to Urdu: A Social and Political History
Tariq_Rahman/Tariq_Rahman__From_Hindi_To.author: Tariq Rahman
Tariq_Rahman/Tariq_Rahman__From_Hindi_To.summary: Tariq Rahman's social history of the Hindi-Urdu language split and the development of Pakistani print culture in Urdu. Field site: Pakistan.

Thomas_H_Johnson/Historical_Dictionary_o.title: Historical Dictionary of Afghanistan
Thomas_H_Johnson/Historical_Dictionary_o.author: Thomas H. Johnson
Thomas_H_Johnson/Historical_Dictionary_o.summary: Ludwig W. Adamec's encyclopedic reference work on Afghanistan. Concise entries on key figures, ethnic groups, geographical features, religious movements, and historical events from antiquity through the modern era. Field site: Afghanistan as a whole.

Thomas_H_Johnson/Understanding_The_Talib.title: Understanding The Taliban And Insurgency In Afghanistan
Thomas_H_Johnson/Understanding_The_Talib.author: Thomas H. Johnson
Thomas_H_Johnson/Understanding_The_Talib.summary: Thomas H. Johnson and M. Chris Mason's 2007 Orbis essay arguing that the Taliban resurgence in Afghanistan is rooted not in Islamism alone but in Pashtun tribal kinship networks, the charismatic-mullah tradition, and a 'war of the flea' insurgency strategy that the U.S. and NATO have failed to counter. Drawing on the authors' Naval Postgraduate School research and field experience, the article traces the movement's origins in Deobandi madrassas of NWFP and FATA, its predominance among the Ghilzai (especially Hotaki tribe) Pashtuns, and the centrality of Provincial Reconstruction Teams to any viable counterinsurgency. Field site: Afghanistan (Pashtun south and east) and the Pakistan border belt. Published in Orbis, Winter 2007.

Umar_Hayat/Empire_s_accidents__Law__lies.title: Empire's accidents
Umar_Hayat/Empire_s_accidents__Law__lies.author: Maira Hayat
Umar_Hayat/Empire_s_accidents__Law__lies.summary: Umar Hayat's analysis of law, lies, and sovereignty in the 'War on Terror' as it played out in Pakistan's tribal areas. Field sites: Waziristan, Anantnag, Peshawar.

Vasja_Badali/The_War_Against_Civilians__.title: The War Against Civilians
Vasja_Badali/The_War_Against_Civilians__.author: Vasja Badalič
Vasja_Badali/The_War_Against_Civilians__.summary: Vasja Badalič's analysis of civilian victims of the 'War on Terror' in Afghanistan and Pakistan, including drone strikes and night raids. Field sites: FATA, Afghanistan.

Veena_Kukreja/Pakistan__Democracy__Devel.title: Pakistan: Democracy, Development and Security Issues
Veena_Kukreja/Pakistan__Democracy__Devel.author: Veena Kukreja
Veena_Kukreja/Pakistan__Democracy__Devel.summary: Veena Kukreja's edited volume on Pakistan's overlapping crises in democracy, development, and security since 1947. Field site: Pakistan (national-level coverage with case studies in Punjab and Sindh). Brings together South Asian political scientists to examine civil-military relations, ethnic conflict, foreign policy, and economic reform. Sage Publications India, 2003.

Victoria_Schofield/Kashmir_In_Conflict_I.title: Kashmir in Conflict: India, Pakistan and the Unending War
Victoria_Schofield/Kashmir_In_Conflict_I.author: Victoria Schofield
Victoria_Schofield/Kashmir_In_Conflict_I.summary: Victoria Schofield's history of Kashmir from Mughal rule through the modern conflict. Synthesizes archival research and interviews with Kashmiri political leaders. Standard accessible reference. Field sites: Srinagar, Jammu, Muzaffarabad, the Line of Control.

Victoria_Schofield/Kashmir_In_Conflict__.title: Kashmir in Conflict: India, Pakistan and the Unending War
Victoria_Schofield/Kashmir_In_Conflict__.author: Victoria Schofield
Victoria_Schofield/Kashmir_In_Conflict__.summary: Victoria Schofield's history of Kashmir from Mughal rule through the modern conflict. Synthesizes archival research and interviews with Kashmiri political leaders. Standard accessible reference. Field sites: Srinagar, Jammu, Muzaffarabad, the Line of Control.

Victoria_W_Miroshnik/How_Pakistan_Was_Fo.title: How Pakistan Was Formed
Victoria_W_Miroshnik/How_Pakistan_Was_Fo.author: Victoria W. Miroshnik
Victoria_W_Miroshnik/How_Pakistan_Was_Fo.summary: Victoria W. Miroshnik's analysis of the economic rationale for Partition. Field site: undivided British India.

Wahid_Hussain/Educational_Anthropology__.title: Educational Anthropology
Wahid_Hussain/Educational_Anthropology__.author: Wahid Ahmad Dar
Wahid_Hussain/Educational_Anthropology__.summary: Wahid Hussain's 'Educational Anthropology' is an ethnographic work on politics law and social organization. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'This is intensely laborious and requires interdisciplinary skills, one reason why few studies of this kind exist.' Field site: Jammu. Published 2018 by Sage.

William_Glover/Making_Lahore_Modern__Con.title: Making Lahore Modern
William_Glover/Making_Lahore_Modern__Con.author: William J. Glover
William_Glover/Making_Lahore_Modern__Con.summary: William J. Glover's classic urban history of colonial Lahore — how British imperial planners and Punjabi residents jointly constructed the colonial city. Field site: Lahore (with Sahiwal, Multan).

William_Maley/Afghanistan___Challenges_a.title: Afghanistan: Challenges and Prospects
William_Maley/Afghanistan___Challenges_a.author: William Maley
William_Maley/Afghanistan___Challenges_a.summary: William Maley's edited volume on post-2001 Afghanistan. Field site: Afghanistan.

William_Maley/Fundamentalism_Reborn___Af.title: Fundamentalism Reborn
William_Maley/Fundamentalism_Reborn___Af.author: William Maley
William_Maley/Fundamentalism_Reborn___Af.summary: William Maley's edited volume on Afghanistan and the Taliban movement, with contributions from leading scholars covering the regime's first emergence in the 1990s. Field site: Afghanistan.

William_Maley/Rescuing_Afghanistan__Brie.title: Rescuing Afghanistan
William_Maley/Rescuing_Afghanistan__Brie.author: William Maley
William_Maley/Rescuing_Afghanistan__Brie.summary: William Maley's policy essay on stabilizing post-Taliban Afghanistan, written in the early 2000s. Field site: Afghanistan.

William_Maley/The_Soviet_Withdrawal_from.title: The Soviet Withdrawal from Afghanistan
William_Maley/The_Soviet_Withdrawal_from.author: William Maley
William_Maley/The_Soviet_Withdrawal_from.summary: William Maley's edited volume documenting the Soviet withdrawal from Afghanistan in 1989 and its diplomatic, military, and political dimensions. Field site: Afghanistan, USSR.

Zafar_Khan/Medicinal_Plant_Biodiversity_.title: Medicinal Plant Biodiversity of Lesser Himalayas-Pakistan
Zafar_Khan/Medicinal_Plant_Biodiversity_.author: Zafar Khan
Zafar_Khan/Medicinal_Plant_Biodiversity_.summary: Arshad Mehmood Abbasi, Mir Ajab Khan, Mushtaq Ahmad and Muhammad Zafar's botanical and ethnobotanical inventory of 100 medicinal plant species from the Lesser Himalayan range of northern Pakistan, with scientific descriptions, traditional medicinal uses, and discussion of anthropogenic pressures. Methodology: ethnobotanical fieldwork combined with herbarium-based plant taxonomy at Quaid-i-Azam University, Islamabad. Field site: Lesser Himalayas of northern Pakistan. Published Springer, New York, 2012. (Companion edition listed under Zafar Khan as additional author.)

Zafar_Khan/Pakistan_s_Nuclear_Policy__A_.title: Pakistan's Nuclear Policy
Zafar_Khan/Pakistan_s_Nuclear_Policy__A_.author: Zafar Khan
Zafar_Khan/Pakistan_s_Nuclear_Policy__A_.summary: Zafar Khan's analysis of Pakistan's minimum-credible-deterrence nuclear policy. Field site: Pakistan.

Zahid_Ahmed/Iran_s_Soft_Power_in_Afghani.title: Iran's Soft Power in Afghanistan and Pakistan
Zahid_Ahmed/Iran_s_Soft_Power_in_Afghani.author: Zahid Shahab Ahmed
Zahid_Ahmed/Iran_s_Soft_Power_in_Afghani.summary: Zahid Shahab Ahmed's analysis of Iranian soft power projection in Afghanistan and Pakistan — religious, cultural, and economic instruments. Field sites: Pakistan and Afghanistan.

Zulfiqar_Ali_Kalhoro/Archaeology_Art_And.title: Archaeology Art And Religion In Sindh
Zulfiqar_Ali_Kalhoro/Archaeology_Art_And.author: Zulfiqar Ali Kalhoro
Zulfiqar_Ali_Kalhoro/Archaeology_Art_And.summary: Zulfiqar Ali Kalhoro's documentation of Sindhi archaeological sites, art, and religious heritage. Field sites: Sindh, Khairpur Mirs.

Anila_Daulatzai/Acknowledging_Afghanista.author: Anila Daulatzai
Anila_Daulatzai/Acknowledging_Afghanista.title: Acknowledging Afghanistan: Notes and Queries on an Occupation
Anila_Daulatzai/Acknowledging_Afghanista.summary: Anila Daulatzai's article 'Acknowledging Afghanistan' offers a critical anthropological reflection on the post-2001 US occupation, drawing on her fieldwork with Afghan widows in Kabul. Daulatzai argues that humanitarian and counterinsurgency frames flatten Afghan ethical life. Field site: Kabul, Afghanistan. Methodology: ethnographic essay with theoretical argument. Published 2008 in Cultural Dynamics.

Anila_Daulatzai/The_Discursive_Occupatio.author: Anila Daulatzai
Anila_Daulatzai/The_Discursive_Occupatio.title: The Discursive Occupation of Afghanistan
Anila_Daulatzai/The_Discursive_Occupatio.summary: Anila Daulatzai's 'The Discursive Occupation of Afghanistan' critiques the framing of post-2001 Afghanistan in Western media and policy discourse, arguing that 'humanitarian' narratives obscure the realities of military occupation. Drawing on fieldwork in Kabul among widows and the urban poor, Daulatzai shows how discursive frames condition material intervention. Field site: Kabul, Afghanistan. Methodology: discourse analysis with ethnographic grounding. Published 2008.

David_B_Edwards/Caravan_of_Martyrs__Sacr.author: David B. Edwards
David_B_Edwards/Caravan_of_Martyrs__Sacr.title: Caravan of Martyrs: Sacrifice and Suicide Bombing in Afghanistan
David_B_Edwards/Caravan_of_Martyrs__Sacr.summary: David B. Edwards' Caravan of Martyrs traces how the Afghan jihad transformed cultural ideas of sacrifice, honor, and Pashtun tribalism into the logic of suicide bombing. Drawing on three decades of fieldwork in Pakistan's North-West Frontier and on audiovisual material produced by jihadi groups, Edwards argues that suicide bombing represents a rupture rather than a continuation of older martial traditions. Field site: Pashtun borderland, especially Peshawar and the tribal areas. Methodology: ethnographic fieldwork with media analysis. Published 2017 by University of California Press.

Christopher_Snedden/Independent_Kashmir_.author: Christopher Snedden
Christopher_Snedden/Independent_Kashmir_.title: Independent Kashmir: An Incomplete Aspiration
Christopher_Snedden/Independent_Kashmir_.summary: Christopher Snedden's Independent Kashmir traces the persistent aspiration for Kashmiri independence from 1846 through the post-2019 abrogation of Article 370, arguing that 'azadi' has remained politically alive across multiple constitutional regimes. Drawing on Indian, Pakistani, and Kashmiri sources, the book synthesizes narratives across all parts of the former princely state. Field sites: Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, Pakistan-administered Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan. Methodology: historical synthesis with interview material. Published 2021.

Sumantra_Bose/Kashmir_at_the_Crossroads_.author: Sumantra Bose
Sumantra_Bose/Kashmir_at_the_Crossroads_.title: Kashmir at the Crossroads: Inside a 21st-Century Conflict
Sumantra_Bose/Kashmir_at_the_Crossroads_.summary: Sumantra Bose's Kashmir at the Crossroads provides a comprehensive 21st-century history of the Kashmir conflict, with particular focus on the 2019 abrogation of Article 370 and its aftermath. Drawing on interviews with Kashmiri political figures and analysis of public documents, Bose situates the current crisis within seventy years of disputed sovereignty. Field site: Srinagar and the Kashmir Valley, with comparative reference to Azad Kashmir. Methodology: political analysis with interviews. Published 2021 by Yale University Press.

Karl_Jettmar/Antiquities_of_Northern_Pak.author: Karl Jettmar
Karl_Jettmar/Antiquities_of_Northern_Pak.title: Antiquities of Northern Pakistan: Reports and Studies, Volume 4
Karl_Jettmar/Antiquities_of_Northern_Pak.summary: Karl Jettmar's Antiquities of Northern Pakistan documents pre-Islamic rock carvings and inscriptions along the upper Indus and its tributaries from Chilas to Hunza, arguing that the region was a long-standing crossroads between South, Central, and East Asian religious traditions. The volumes catalogue Buddhist, Zoroastrian, Hindu, and shamanic motifs at sites including Hodar, Sazin, and Thalpan. Field sites: Chilas, Hodar, Sazin, Thalpan along the upper Indus, Pakistan. Methodology: archaeological survey and epigraphic analysis. Published 1989 onward by Philipp von Zabern.

Akbar_S_Ahmed/Millennium_and_Charisma_Am.author: Akbar S. Ahmed
Akbar_S_Ahmed/Millennium_and_Charisma_Am.title: Millennium and Charisma among Pathans: A Critical Essay in Social Anthropology
Akbar_S_Ahmed/Millennium_and_Charisma_Am.summary: Akbar S. Ahmed's Millennium and Charisma among Pathans is an ethnographic and theoretical study of millenarian Sufi movements among Pukhtuns in Pakistan's North-West Frontier, focusing on the Akbarid uprising in Swat. The book argues for a structural-functional reading of charismatic leadership that rejects Barth's individualist transactional model. Field sites: Swat, Mohmand, Pakistani Pukhtun tribal areas. Methodology: ethnographic fieldwork and historical reconstruction. Published 1976 by Routledge & Kegan Paul.

Ather_Zia/A_Desolation_Called_Peace__Voi.author: Ather Zia
Ather_Zia/A_Desolation_Called_Peace__Voi.title: A Desolation Called Peace: Voices from Kashmir
Ather_Zia/A_Desolation_Called_Peace__Voi.summary: A Desolation Called Peace, edited by Ather Zia and Javaid Iqbal Bhat, gathers essays, poems, and testimonies from Kashmiri writers documenting life under Indian military occupation. The volume combines literary and ethnographic registers to record voices from Srinagar, Kupwara, and Pulwama. Field sites: Kashmir Valley. Methodology: edited literary-ethnographic anthology. Published 2019 by HarperCollins India.

Ather_Zia/Resisting_Disappearance_by_Ath.author: Ather Zia
Ather_Zia/Resisting_Disappearance_by_Ath.title: Resisting Disappearance: Military Occupation and Women's Activism in Kashmir
Ather_Zia/Resisting_Disappearance_by_Ath.summary: Ather Zia's Resisting Disappearance is an ethnography of the Association of Parents of Disappeared Persons (APDP) in Kashmir, focusing on the half-widows and mothers who pursue missing relatives across decades of Indian military occupation. Zia argues that 'affective justice work' constitutes a distinct form of women's political agency. Field site: Srinagar and the Kashmir Valley. Methodology: long-term participant observation with APDP. Published 2019 by University of Washington Press.

Ather_Zia/Resisting_Occupation_in_Kashmi.author: Ather Zia
Ather_Zia/Resisting_Occupation_in_Kashmi.title: Resisting Occupation in Kashmir
Ather_Zia/Resisting_Occupation_in_Kashmi.summary: Resisting Occupation in Kashmir, edited by Haley Duschinski, Mona Bhan, Ather Zia, and Cynthia Mahmood, gathers chapters by Kashmir scholars analyzing Indian military occupation, everyday violence, and political resistance after 1989. Contributions include ethnographic and historical work on Srinagar, Kupwara, and other Valley districts. Field sites: Kashmir Valley districts (Srinagar, Kupwara, Anantnag). Methodology: edited interdisciplinary volume. Published 2018 by University of Pennsylvania Press.

Sana_Haroon/The_Mosques_of_Colonial_Sout.author: Sana Haroon
Sana_Haroon/The_Mosques_of_Colonial_Sout.title: The Mosques of Colonial South Asia: A Social and Legal History of Muslim Worship
Sana_Haroon/The_Mosques_of_Colonial_Sout.summary: Sana Haroon's The Mosques of Colonial South Asia is a legal and social history of mosque construction, sect dispute, and congregational practice in late-colonial India and Pakistan. Drawing on Indian and British court records, Haroon shows how colonial law constructed Muslim 'community' through property disputes. Field sites: Punjab, Sindh, North-West Frontier, and United Provinces. Methodology: legal and archival history. Published 2021 by Cambridge University Press.

Magnus_Marsden/Living_Islam__Muslim_Reli.author: Magnus Marsden
Magnus_Marsden/Living_Islam__Muslim_Reli.title: Living Islam: Muslim Religious Experience in Pakistan's North-West Frontier
Magnus_Marsden/Living_Islam__Muslim_Reli.summary: Magnus Marsden's Living Islam is a long-term ethnography of Muslim religious life in Chitral, in Pakistan's North-West Frontier (now Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), arguing against narratives that reduce frontier Islam to militancy. Marsden documents Sunni-Ismaili-Shia debate, poetry recitation, and Sufi discipleship across Chitrali villages. Field sites: Chitral District (Rowshan, Markaz), Pakistan. Methodology: extended ethnographic fieldwork. Published 2005 by Cambridge University Press.

Christine_Fair/Fighting_to_the_End__The_.author: C. Christine Fair
Christine_Fair/Fighting_to_the_End__The_.title: Fighting to the End: The Pakistan Army's Way of War
Christine_Fair/Fighting_to_the_End__The_.summary: Christine Fair's Fighting to the End argues that the Pakistan Army's strategic culture treats the existential rivalry with India as the decisive frame for all foreign and domestic policy, drawing on a systematic content analysis of Pakistani military journals. Fair's argument explains why the army maintains militant proxies despite their costs. Field site: Pakistan (military institutional analysis, Rawalpindi, Islamabad). Methodology: content analysis of Pakistani military doctrinal literature. Published 2014 by Oxford University Press.

Mubbashir_Rizvi/From_terrorism_to_dispos.author: Mubbashir A. Rizvi
Mubbashir_Rizvi/From_terrorism_to_dispos.title: From Terrorism to Dispossession: Pakistan's Anti-Terrorism Act as a Means of Eviction
Mubbashir_Rizvi/From_terrorism_to_dispos.summary: Mubbashir Rizvi's 'From terrorism to dispossession: Pakistan s Anti Terrorism Act as a means of eviction' is an ethnographic article on agrarian and pastoral life, ethnicity and identity politics, and gender and women's experience. Regional focus: Pakistan. Field site: Okāra District. Published 2018 by Anthropology Today.

Mubbashir_Rizvi/The_Ethics_of_Staying__S.author: Mubbashir A. Rizvi
Mubbashir_Rizvi/The_Ethics_of_Staying__S.title: The Ethics of Staying: Social Movements and Land Rights Politics in Pakistan
Mubbashir_Rizvi/The_Ethics_of_Staying__S.summary: Mubbashir Rizvi's The Ethics of Staying is an ethnography of the Anjuman Mazareen Punjab tenant movement in Okara, Punjab, where peasants resist Pakistan Army efforts to convert occupancy tenancy into corporate leases. Rizvi argues that the slogan 'malki ya maut' (ownership or death) articulates a vernacular ethics of place. Field site: Okara military farms, Punjab, Pakistan. Methodology: ethnographic fieldwork with tenant activists. Published 2019 by Stanford University Press.

Mubbashir_Rizvi/The_moral_ecology_of_col.author: Mubbashir A. Rizvi
Mubbashir_Rizvi/The_moral_ecology_of_col.title: The moral ecology of colonial infrastructure and the vicissitudes of land rights in rural Pakistan
Mubbashir_Rizvi/The_moral_ecology_of_col.summary: Mubbashir Rizvi's 'The moral ecology of colonial infrastructure and the vicissitudes of land rights in rural Pakistan' is a historical article on agrarian and pastoral life, politics and conflict, and religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Eight tenants were killed, and dozens arrested, tortured and tried in special anti-terrorism courts (HRW 2004).' Field site: Okāra District, Lahore District. Published 2016.

Charles_Lindholm/The_Struggle_for_the_Wo.author: Charles Lindholm
Charles_Lindholm/The_Struggle_for_the_Wo.title: The Struggle for the World: Liberation Movements for the 21st Century
Charles_Lindholm/The_Struggle_for_the_Wo.summary: Charles Lindholm's 'The Struggle for the World: Liberation Movements for the 21st Century' is a historical monograph on ethnicity and identity politics, gender and women's experience, and politics and conflict. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Despite our different disciplinary backgrounds, each of us has a strong interest in the culture, history, psychology, and structure of social movements and political organizations.' Field site: Peshawar Division. Published 2010 by Stanford University Press.

Charles_Lindholm/The_struggle_for_the_wo.author: Charles Lindholm
Charles_Lindholm/The_struggle_for_the_wo.title: The struggle for the world: liberation movements for the 21st century
Charles_Lindholm/The_struggle_for_the_wo.summary: Charles Lindholm's 'The struggle for the world: liberation movements for the 21st century' is a historical monograph on politics and conflict, religion and ritual, and trade and economy. Regional focus: Pakistan. Field site: Peshawar Division. Published 2013.

Sonia_Ahsan_Tirmizi/Pious_Peripheries__b.author: Sonia Ahsan-Tirmizi
Sonia_Ahsan_Tirmizi/Pious_Peripheries__b.title: Pious Peripheries: Runaway Women in Post-Taliban Afghanistan
Sonia_Ahsan_Tirmizi/Pious_Peripheries__b.summary: Sonia Ahsan-Tirmizi's Pious Peripheries is an ethnography of women's shelters in Kabul, where 'runaway' women — those fleeing forced marriage or domestic violence — negotiate Islamic ethics, state law, and donor expectations. The book argues that piety provides a vocabulary for women's self-fashioning under post-2001 reconstruction. Field site: Kabul, Afghanistan. Methodology: ethnographic fieldwork with shelter residents and staff. Published 2021 by Stanford University Press.

Fredrik_Barth/Ethnic_Groups_and_Boundari.author: Fredrik Barth
Fredrik_Barth/Ethnic_Groups_and_Boundari.title: Ethnic Groups and Boundaries: The Social Organization of Culture Difference
Fredrik_Barth/Ethnic_Groups_and_Boundari.summary: Fredrik Barth's Ethnic Groups and Boundaries reframes ethnicity as the maintenance of social boundaries rather than the content of cultural traits, with case studies including the Pathans of Pakistan and Afghanistan. Barth's introduction proposes that boundaries persist despite cross-boundary flow of people and practices. Field sites: Swat (Pakistan) and other comparative cases. Methodology: theoretical synthesis with ethnographic case studies. Published 1969 by Allen & Unwin.

Fredrik_Barth/On_Two_Views_of_the_Swat_P.author: Fredrik Barth
Fredrik_Barth/On_Two_Views_of_the_Swat_P.title: On Two Views of the Swat Pushtun and Comments
Fredrik_Barth/On_Two_Views_of_the_Swat_P.summary: Fredrik Barth's article 'On Two Views of the Swat Pushtun' responds to Akbar S. Ahmed's structural-functional critique of Barth's transactional model of Pukhtun social organization. Barth defends his interpretation of Yusufzai segmentary lineage and chiefly competition based on his 1950s Swat fieldwork. Field site: Swat valley, Pakistan. Methodology: theoretical exchange grounded in ethnographic data. Published 1981 in Current Anthropology.

ADRIAN_MAYER/Peasants_In_Pacific_Ils_67_.author: Adrian C. Mayer
ADRIAN_MAYER/Peasants_In_Pacific_Ils_67_.title: Peasants in the Pacific: A Study of Fiji Indian Rural Society
ADRIAN_MAYER/Peasants_In_Pacific_Ils_67_.summary: Adrian Mayer's 'Peasants In Pacific Ils' is an economic monograph on agrarian and pastoral life, gender and women's experience, and kinship and family. Regional focus: Pakistan. Field site: Dayal. Published 2007 by Routledge.

A_Aiyappan/REPORT_ON_THE_SOCIO-ECONOMIC_.author: A. Aiyappan
A_Aiyappan/REPORT_ON_THE_SOCIO-ECONOMIC_.title: Report on the Socio-economic Conditions of the Aboriginal Tribes of the Province of Madras
A_Aiyappan/REPORT_ON_THE_SOCIO-ECONOMIC_.summary: A Aiyappan's 'Report on the Socio-economic Conditions of the Aboriginal Tribes of the Province of Madras' is an economic monograph on agrarian and pastoral life, kinship and family, and politics and conflict. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'The Aboriginal Tribes Welfare Enquiry Committee, constituted in 1946 prepared this report.' Field site: Hyderabad, Mand, Kallar, Kora. Published 2000.

A_Aiyappan/Report_of_the_Committee_on_So.author: A. Aiyappan
A_Aiyappan/Report_of_the_Committee_on_So.title: Report of the Committee on Social Science Research
A_Aiyappan/Report_of_the_Committee_on_So.summary: A Aiyappan's 'Report of the Committee on Social Science Research' is an economic monograph on agrarian and pastoral life and politics and conflict. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'It was an ad-hoc committee not having powers similar to full-fledged commissions.' Field site: Hyderabad. Published 1964.

A_Desai/STUDIES_IN_INDIAN_EPIGRAPHY__Bha.author: A Desai
A_Desai/STUDIES_IN_INDIAN_EPIGRAPHY__Bha.title: STUDIES IN INDIAN EPIGRAPHY: Bharatiya Purābhilekha Patrikā: JOURNAL OF THE EPIGRAPHICAL SOCIETY OF INDIA VOLUME ONE
A_Desai/STUDIES_IN_INDIAN_EPIGRAPHY__Bha.summary: A Desai's 'STUDIES IN INDIAN EPIGRAPHY: Bharatiya Purābhilekha Patrikā: JOURNAL OF THE EPIGRAPHICAL SOCIETY OF INDIA VOLUME ONE: indian-epigraphy-vol-1-compressed' is a historical monograph on kinship and family and politics and conflict. Regional focus: Pakistan, Afghanistan. From the opening: 'Studies in Indian Epigraphy creation, preservation and destruction and not different ones as suggested by «Yamada.' Field site: Pūnch, Kandahār. Published 1972.

A_Desai/STUDIES_IN_INDIAN_EPIGRAPHY__Bha.author: A Desai
A_Desai/STUDIES_IN_INDIAN_EPIGRAPHY__Bha.title: Studies in Indian Epigraphy (Bharatiya Purabhilekha Patrika): Journal of the Epigraphical Society of India, Volume 2
A_Desai/STUDIES_IN_INDIAN_EPIGRAPHY__Bha.summary: A Desai's 'STUDIES IN INDIAN EPIGRAPHY: Bharatiya Purābhilekha Patrikā: JOURNAL OF THE EPIGRAPHICAL SOCIETY OF INDIA VOLUME two: jesi-vol-2' is a historical monograph on politics and conflict and trade and economy. Regional focus: Pakistan. From the opening: 'Studies in Indian Epigraphy—tIl With your permission, Ladies and Gentlemen, I would first of all emphasize the role and importance of epigraphy.' Field site: Bagh, Harappa. Published 1972.

A_H_Bittles/Consanguinity_as_a_Determina.author: Alan H. Bittles
A_H_Bittles/Consanguinity_as_a_Determina.title: Consanguinity as a Determinant of Reproductive Behaviour and Mortality in Pakistan
A_H_Bittles/Consanguinity_as_a_Determina.summary: A H Bittles's 'Consanguinity as a Determinant of Reproductive Behaviour and Mortality in Pakistan' is an ethnographic article on kinship and family and religion and ritual. Regional focus: Pakistan. Field site: Lahore District. Published 2016.
